English: The Hunt for Vela Callose
Chinese: 追捕薇拉·卡洛斯

English: You've been trapped in a cell for some time.
Chinese: 你被关在牢房里已有些时日。

English: After months of confinement in an Inquisition prison, you've been released on one condition: you must apprehend Vela Callose, the most dangerous person in the skyrealms. She is in the fortress nearby. ##You may seek further assistance from Inquisitor Ignavius en route. But first, you must obtain and equip a weapon...
Chinese: 在宗教裁判所监狱被关押数月后，你获得释放，条件只有一个：缉拿天空领域最危险的人物——薇拉·卡洛斯。她就在附近的堡垒里。##路上你可以向伊格纳修斯审判官寻求帮助。但首先，你得弄到一件武器并装备上……

English: After months of confinement in an Inquisition prison, you've been released on one condition: you must apprehend Vela Callose, the most dangerous person in the skyrealms. She is in the fortress nearby. ##You may seek further assistance from Inquisitor Ignavius en route.
Chinese: 在宗教裁判所监狱被关押数月后，你获得释放，条件只有一个：缉拿天空领域最危险的人物——薇拉·卡洛斯。她就在附近的堡垒里。##路上你可以向伊格纳修斯审判官寻求帮助。

English: After months of confinement in an Inquisition prison, you've been released on one condition: you must apprehend Vela Callose, the most dangerous person in the skyrealms. She is in the fortress nearby. ##Inquisitor Ignavius has informed you of an alternate way into the fortress, accessed by a stairwell on the side, that may require less bloodshed.
Chinese: 在宗教裁判所监狱被关押数月后，你获得释放，条件只有一个：缉拿天空领域最危险的人物——薇拉·卡洛斯。她就在附近的堡垒里。##伊格纳修斯审判官告诉你一条潜入堡垒的替代路线：从侧面的楼梯井进入，可以少流些血。

English: You confronted Vela Callose - the dangerous mercenary leader - but failed to apprehend her as per your deal with the Inquisition. ##You should return to the High Confessor and seek penitence.
Chinese: 你与危险的佣兵头目薇拉·卡洛斯正面交锋，却未能按与宗教裁判所的约定将她缉拿。##你应该回到至高忏悔者那里，请求宽恕。

English: Your search for Vela Callose continues. ##The High Confessor has tasked you with meeting Vela's former quartermaster in the [[Wobbly Noggin pub]] in Hallowshire, past the Union gatebridge.##To proceed, you will need to obtain a [[Union Passport]] from somewhere in Pwyll.
Chinese: 你对薇拉·卡洛斯的追捕仍在继续。##至高忏悔者命你穿过联盟关卡桥，到哈洛郡的[[摇晃酒馆]]与薇拉的前军需官会面。##要继续前进，你需要从普威尔某处弄到一本[[联盟护照]]。

English: Jack Basalt - Vela's former quartermaster - has told you of three former Dark Star mercenaries who could aid you in the hunt for Vela. ##Track each of them down and recruit them to your cause.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特——薇拉的前军需官——向你提到三名前黑星佣兵，他们或许能在追捕薇拉的行动中助你一臂之力。##把每个人都找出来，招募到你的事业中。

English: You have found and recruited a small crew of former Dark Star mercenaries. With their help, your hunt for Vela can begin in earnest. ##Report back to the High Confessor in the Blinding Light to plan your next course of action.
Chinese: 你已找到并招募了一小队前黑星佣兵。有他们相助，追捕薇拉的行动可以全面展开。##回炫光要塞向至高忏悔者复命，商定下一步行动计划。

English: The High Confessor has asked you to [[activate]] the Blinding Light Fortress. Return to the cockpit where you first confronted Vela and [[access the controls.]]
Chinese: 至高忏悔者请你[[启动]]炫光要塞。回到你首次与薇拉交锋的驾驶舱，[[操作控制台]]。

English: You have activated the Blinding Light, which it turns out is actually a fully-functioning airship. ##Return to the High Confessor to plan your next move.
Chinese: 你启动了炫光要塞——它原来是一艘功能完备的飞艇。##回到至高忏悔者那里，商定下一步行动。

English: The High Confessor has tasked you with venturing into the [[Underlands]] in your pursuit of Vela Callose. ##When you are ready, use the [[control panel]] of the small cutter vessel - stowed in the Blinding Light's inner dock - to instigate the expedition.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者命你前往[[地下之地]]追捕薇拉·卡洛斯。##准备就绪后，使用停泊在炫光要塞内坞的小艇[[控制面板]]，开启远征。

English: The High Confessor has tasked you with venturing into the [[Underlands]] in your pursuit of Vela Callose, but the cutter crash landed on arrival. ##You must make your way through the Underlands and apprehend Vela.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者命你前往[[地下之地]]追捕薇拉·卡洛斯，但小艇在着陆时坠毁。##你必须穿越地下之地，将薇拉缉拿归案。

English: You confronted Vela Callose in the Underlands, but she ran you through with her blade - causing you to be plucked from near-death by your guardian-god. ##You should report to the High Confessor back at the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 你在地下之地与薇拉·卡洛斯正面交锋，却被她一剑穿身——你的守护神把你从死亡边缘拉了回来。##你应该回炫光要塞向至高忏悔者复命。

English: Vela Callose has commandeered the Cradle - an ancient Embieran craft that harbours a powerful entity. ##No vessel can pierce its protective shielding, so you must obtain an [[airship]] and explore the [[distant islands]] for a means to upgrade the cutter.
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯强占了摇篮——一艘收容着强大实体的古余烬巨构。##没有任何船能穿透它的防护护盾，所以你必须弄到一艘[[飞艇]]，探索[[遥远岛屿]]，寻找升级小艇的办法。

English: Vela Callose has commandeered the Cradle - an ancient Embieran craft that harbours a powerful entity. ##You've upgraded the cutter with the Rasmussen Sphere, allowing you to mount an assault. Speak with your Dark Star comrades and, when ready, activate the cutter's [[control panel]].
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯强占了摇篮——一艘收容着强大实体的古余烬巨构。##你已用拉斯穆森球体完成小艇升级，可以发动进攻了。与你的黑星同伴们谈谈，准备就绪后启动小艇的[[控制面板]]。

English: You have mounted an assault on the Cradle with your Dark Star companions. ##Make your way past the Dark Star mercenaries and confront Vela Callose for the final time.
Chinese: 你与黑星同伴们一起向摇篮发起了进攻。##穿过黑星佣兵的防线，与薇拉·卡洛斯作最后的对决。

English: It has been a long journey, but you have finally thwarted Vela Callose - the most powerful outlaw in the skyrealms - and have confronted the Angel she unearthed from the Underlands.
Chinese: 漫长的旅程终告一段落，你最终挫败了天空领域最强悍的法外之徒薇拉·卡洛斯，并与她从地下之地掘出的天使正面相对。

English: Cradle Assault
Chinese: 突袭摇篮

English: You have launched an assault on the Cradle. ##Having reached the front dock with the cutter, you must make the rest of the way on foot.
Chinese: 你已向摇篮发起进攻。##小艇已抵达前坞，剩下的路你得靠双脚走完。

English: You have launched an assault on the Cradle, and must now find a way inside the structure. ##The main entrance is impenetrable, but Caxton Frost had planned to find some sort of back entrance; you should rendezvous with him.
Chinese: 你已向摇篮发起进攻，现在必须设法进入建筑内部。##正门无法通行，不过卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特计划找一条后门之类的入口；你应该去和他会合。

English: You have launched an assault on the Cradle and must now find a way inside the structure. ##Caxton Frost has found a way through an aeration pipe, but the turbine must be disabled. He has told you to find a [[fail-safe switch]] on the lower levels, below where the cutter docked.
Chinese: 你已向摇篮发起进攻，现在必须设法进入建筑内部。##卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特找到一条穿过通风管道的路，但必须先关掉涡轮。他让你在下方楼层、小艇停靠处的下面找一个[[保险开关]]。

English: By using the fail-safe switch, you have disabled the [[turbine]] of an aeration pipe, which should grant access to the Cradle's main structure. ##You should take an elevator back to the [[main level]] and [[access the pipe.]]
Chinese: 你扳下保险开关，关停了一条通风管道的[[涡轮]]，应该能由此进入摇篮主体结构。##乘电梯回到[[主层]]，[[进入管道]]。

English: By using the fail-safe switch, you have disabled the [[turbine]] of an aeration pipe, which should grant access to the Cradle's main structure. ##You found that some of your companions, however, did not survive.
Chinese: 你扳下保险开关，关停了一条通风管道的[[涡轮]]，应该能由此进入摇篮主体结构。##然而你发现，一些同伴没能活下来。

English: You have gained access to the Cradle's main structure. ##You need to find a way through, so as to confront Vela.
Chinese: 你已进入摇篮主体结构。##你需要找到一条通路，去与薇拉对决。

English: You have gained access to the Cradle's main structure. ##A holographic entity told you that the Angel has replicated itself - and this smaller Angel Spawn blocks your path. But If you find four [[override switches]] scattered around the Cradle, you may be able to disable it without a fight.
Chinese: 你已进入摇篮主体结构。##一个全息实体告诉你，天使已经自我复制——眼前这个较小的天使幼体挡住了去路。不过，只要找到散布在摇篮各处的四个[[超控开关]]，你或许能不动干戈地让它停摆。

English: Having gained access to the Cradle's main structure, you have managed to defeat a replicated spawn of the Angel in combat. ##Nothing now stands between you and Vela.
Chinese: 进入摇篮主体结构后，你已在战斗中击败了一个天使的复制幼体。##你和薇拉之间再无阻碍。

English: Having gained access to the Cradle's main structure, you have managed to defeat a replicated spawn of the Angel by overriding the power relay system. ##Nothing now stands between you and Vela.
Chinese: 进入摇篮主体结构后，你已通过超控电力中继系统，让一个天使复制幼体停摆。##你和薇拉之间再无阻碍。

English: In the depths of the Cradle you have found Vela - but she won't go down without a fight.
Chinese: 在摇篮深处你找到了薇拉——但她绝不会束手就擒。

English: In the depths of the Cradle you found Vela, and you managed to convince her to stand down. ##Now, all that remains is to confront this so-called Angel.
Chinese: 在摇篮深处你找到了薇拉，并成功说服她放下武器。##现在，只剩那个所谓的天使需要面对了。

English: In the depths of the Cradle you found Vela, and you managed to defeat her in combat. ##Now, all that remains is to confront this so-called Angel.
Chinese: 在摇篮深处你找到了薇拉，并在战斗中将她击败。##现在，只剩那个所谓的天使需要面对了。

English: In the depths of the Cradle - with Vela no longer a threat - all that remains is to confront this so-called Angel.
Chinese: 在摇篮深处——薇拉已不成威胁——只剩那个所谓的天使需要面对了。

English: You conversed with the Angel - an entity more powerful than even a god - and have decided the very fate of the world.
Chinese: 你与天使——一个比神明还要强大的存在——交谈，并决定了世界的最终命运。

English: Underlands
Chinese: 地下之地

English: You have arrived at the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##Your cutter has crashed, and the air is thick with a deadly miasma. You must press on.
Chinese: 你已抵达地下之地，即将与薇拉·卡洛斯对决。##你的小艇坠毁了，空气中弥漫着致命的瘴气。你必须继续前进。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##There is an autocoach station that may grant swift access into the city; you should investigate.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##有一座自动车厢站台也许能让你快速进城；你应该去调查一下。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##There is an autocoach station that may grant swift access into the city, but the autocoach needs some sort of [[key]]. Your only hope is to search the [[mushroom forest]] below.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##有一座自动车厢站台也许能让你快速进城，但自动车厢需要某种[[钥匙]]。唯一的希望是搜一搜下方的[[蘑菇森林]]。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##There is an autocoach station that may grant swift access into the city, and you have procured a [[autocoach key]]. You should rendezvous with the rest of your crew at the station.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##有一座自动车厢站台也许能让你快速进城，你已弄到一把[[自动车厢钥匙]]。去站台与你的其他船员会合吧。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##There is an autocoach station that may grant swift access into the city, and you have procured a [[autocoach key]]. You should use it with the [[autocoach controls]].
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##有一座自动车厢站台也许能让你快速进城，你已弄到一把[[自动车厢钥匙]]。把它用在[[自动车厢控制台]]上吧。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have activated an autocoach that should take you into the ruined city ahead.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你已启动一辆自动车厢，它应该能载你进入前方的废都。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have arrived in the dense urban ruins of a former Emberian city. You must press ahead and find a way to reach Vela.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你已抵达一座古余烬城市密密麻麻的都市废墟。你必须继续前进，找到通往薇拉的路。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have found a large amphitheatre structure with an autocoach at its peak, but there is no way up from this level. You may have to venture downwards in order to find a way up.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你发现一座大型圆形剧场建筑，顶端停着一辆自动车厢，但从这一层上不去。你可能得先往下走，才能找到向上的路。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have descended into the long-abandoned slum district; perhaps there is a way to ascend one of the nearby sky-scraping structures?
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你已下到久已废弃的贫民窟城区；也许附近哪座高耸入云的建筑有路可以上去？

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have ascended to the top of some exceptionally tall structures. You should make your way to the [[autocoach]] at the top of the tallest building.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你已登上几座极其高耸的建筑顶端。前往最高建筑顶部的[[自动车厢]]吧。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have reached the Cradle, a truly vast structure. You should venture inside and confront Vela Callose.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你已抵达摇篮——一座真正浩瀚的巨构。进去直面薇拉·卡洛斯吧。

English: You are making your way through the Underlands to confront Vela Callose. ##You have reached the Cradle, a truly vast structure. You should venture inside and confront Vela Callose.
Chinese: 你正穿越地下之地，追缉薇拉·卡洛斯。##你已抵达摇篮——一座真正浩瀚的巨构。进去直面薇拉·卡洛斯吧。

English: You confronted Vela Callose in the underlands, before she ran you through with her sword.
Chinese: 你在地下之地与薇拉·卡洛斯正面交锋，随后被她一剑穿身。

English: The Quartermaster
Chinese: 军需官

English: You've been tasked with meeting Vela's former quartermaster in the Wobbly Noggin pub in Hallowshire, past the Union gatebridge. ##He has information relating to your hunt for Vela.
Chinese: 你受命穿过联盟关卡桥，前往哈洛郡的摇晃酒馆与薇拉的前军需官会面。##他掌握着与你追捕薇拉相关的情报。

English: You've successfully recruited Jack Basalt in your hunt for Vela. ##He has returned to Vela's fortress, the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 你成功招募了杰克·巴索特参与追捕薇拉。##他已回到薇拉的旧堡垒——炫光要塞。

English: The Emberian
Chinese: 余烬人

English: Jack Basalt has told you of the 'Emberian' - a former Dark Star mercenary who wears a full suit of ancient Emberian armour. ##Before you recruit her, you have to find her first. You should ask around Hallow Town; perhaps the shopkeepers have seen her.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特向你提起了"余烬人"——一名身穿全套古余烬铠甲的前黑星佣兵。##招募她之前，你得先找到她。去哈洛镇四处打听打听；说不定店主们见过她。

English: You must recruit the 'Emberian' - a former Dark Star mercenary who wears a full suit of ancient Emberian armour. ##The Innkeep of the Wobbly Noggin thinks she is staying in the forest, to the west. Perhaps someone else knows more.
Chinese: 你必须招募"余烬人"——一名身穿全套古余烬铠甲的前黑星佣兵。##摇晃酒馆的店主觉得她住在西边的森林里。也许还有别人知道更多。

English: You must recruit the 'Emberian' - a former Dark Star mercenary who wears a full suit of ancient Emberian armour. ##The shopkeep in the Emporium of Oddities thinks she is camping in the forest to the west, near a giant rusty turbine.
Chinese: 你必须招募"余烬人"——一名身穿全套古余烬铠甲的前黑星佣兵。##奇物商场的店主觉得她在西边森林里扎营，就在一台生锈的巨型涡轮附近。

English: You have spoken with the Emberian in her camp in the Hallowshire forest, but she refuses to help you. ##Perhaps you can glean more information about where she's headed next, either from her - or from her camp.
Chinese: 你在哈洛郡森林的营地与余烬人谈过，但她拒绝帮你。##也许你可以从她本人——或者从她的营地——打探到她下一步去向的更多线索。

English: You have spoken with the Emberian, who refuses to help you. ##But you've found a note that points to a shop with a crystal spire, where she purchased some sort of key. You should find this shop.
Chinese: 你与余烬人谈过，但她拒绝帮你。##不过你发现一张字条，指向一家带水晶尖塔的店铺，她在那里买过某种钥匙。你应该找到这家店。

English: You have spoken with the Emberian, who refuses to help you. ##She's headed to the Emberian ruins in Rustburg, with a key that she purchased from a shop with a crystal spire. You should find this shop.
Chinese: 你与余烬人谈过，但她拒绝帮你。##她带着从一家带水晶尖塔的店铺买来的钥匙，前往锈堡的余烬遗迹。你应该找到这家店。

English: If you're going to follow the Emberian on her quest, you need a specific key. ##The Emporium of Oddities in Hallow Town has one - but the shopkeep won't let it go for less than twenty coin.
Chinese: 如果你想追随余烬人踏上她的旅途，你需要一把特定的钥匙。##哈洛镇的奇物商场有一把——但店主低于 20 硬币绝不出手。

English: You've obtained a key that will let you follow the Emberian. ##It unlocks the Emberian ruins in the town of Rustburg, located in southeast Hallowshire.
Chinese: 你已弄到一把钥匙，可以追随余烬人了。##它能打开锈堡镇的余烬遗迹，那里位于哈洛郡东南。

English: You've found the town of Rustburg in southeast Hallowshire. ##Your key should unlock an old ruin somewhere in the town, which is exactly where the Emberian is headed...
Chinese: 你找到了哈洛郡东南的锈堡镇。##你的钥匙应该能打开镇上某处的古遗迹——那正是余烬人要去的地方……

English: You found the Emberian in the Rustburg ruin, resting by a sealed door. Perhaps you can help her unlock it...
Chinese: 你在锈堡遗迹找到了余烬人，她正在一扇封死的门前歇息。也许你能帮她把门打开……

English: You unlocked the sealed door in the Rustburg ruin. ##Perhaps, with her quest complete, the Emberian will be more amenable to helping you.
Chinese: 你打开了锈堡遗迹中封死的门。##她的旅途既已完成，余烬人也许更愿意帮你了。

English: You have successfully recruited the Emberian to your cause, and she has joined you in Vela's old fortress, the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 你成功把余烬人招募到你的事业中，她已加入你在薇拉旧堡垒——炫光要塞——的行列。

English: You have successfully recruited the Emberian to your cause, and she has joined you in Vela's old fortress, the Blinding Light. ##You convinced her to seek revenge against her former comrade, Vela.
Chinese: 你成功把余烬人招募到你的事业中，她已加入你在薇拉旧堡垒——炫光要塞——的行列。##你说服她向前同伴薇拉复仇。

English: You have successfully recruited the Emberian to your cause. ##You convinced her that there may be some way to reconcile with Vela.
Chinese: 你成功把余烬人招募到你的事业中。##你说服她相信，也许还有办法与薇拉和解。

English: You have successfully recruited the Emberian to your cause, but she does not agree with your professed motives of helping Vela.
Chinese: 你成功把余烬人招募到你的事业中，但她并不认同你宣称的帮助薇拉的动机。

English: The Endless Duchess
Chinese: 无尽女公爵

English: You've heard of a Dark Star mercenary known only as 'The Duchess'.
Chinese: 你听说过一名黑星佣兵，人们只知道她叫"女公爵"。

English: Jack Basalt has told you of the 'Duchess' - one of Vela's former crew who is a powerful Endless witch. ##Basalt thinks she has returned to her ancestral home in the Endless Realm; you should start there.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特向你提起了"女公爵"——薇拉的前船员之一，一位强大的无尽女巫。##巴索特认为她已回到无尽领域的祖宅；你应该从那里找起。

English: In your search for the Duchess, you've learned that the former Dark Star resides in her family manor at the southern edge of the Endless Realm.
Chinese: 追寻女公爵的途中，你得知这位前黑星住在无尽领域南缘她的家族庄园里。

English: In your search for Vela's comrades, you've learned that a former Dark Star - The Duchess - resides in her manor at the southern edge of the Endless Realm. ##You have spoken to her groundskeeper, who warned that skeletons and magical puzzles block the way.
Chinese: 追寻薇拉同伴的途中，你得知前黑星"女公爵"住在无尽领域南缘她的庄园里。##你与她的园丁谈过，他警告说骷髅和魔法谜题挡在路上。

English: In an abandoned manor on the southern edge of the Endless Realm, you found a witch who could be Vela's former comrade; the Duchess. ##You should speak with this witch and find out more.
Chinese: 在无尽领域南缘一座废弃的庄园里，你找到了一个女巫，她可能就是薇拉的前同伴——女公爵。##你应该和这位女巫谈谈，了解更多情况。

English: You've spoken to the Duchess, who has promised to help you hunt down Vela if you recover her daughter. ##You must meet with a contact in the Rotten Coffin in Sepulchre, who wears a full suit of armour. He can help you further.
Chinese: 你与女公爵谈过，她承诺只要你找回她的女儿，就帮你追捕薇拉。##你必须去陵墓城的烂棺材见一位联络人，他穿着全套铠甲。他能给你进一步的帮助。

English: You've spoken to the Duchess, who has promised to help you hunt down Vela if you recover her daughter. ##You have met with a contact in the Rotten Coffin in Sepulchre, who has demanded a sample of your flesh. There may be no other way...
Chinese: 你与女公爵谈过，她承诺只要你找回她的女儿，就帮你追捕薇拉。##你已在陵墓城的烂棺材见过那位联络人，他要你交出一块血肉样本。也许没有别的办法了……

English: In your search for the Duchess' daughter, you've obtained a key that will unlock the upper levels of Cadaver Keep. ##The Keep is located on the northern tip of the Endless Realm.
Chinese: 寻找女公爵女儿的途中，你弄到一把能打开尸骸要塞上层的钥匙。##要塞位于无尽领域的北端。

English: In your search for the Duchess' daughter, you've arrived at Cadaver Keep on the northern tip of the Endless Realm. The key you obtained should activate an elevator somewhere - taking you to the island where the daughter is being held.
Chinese: 寻找女公爵女儿的途中，你已抵达无尽领域北端的尸骸要塞。你弄到的钥匙应该能启动某处的电梯——载你前往囚禁她女儿的岛屿。

English: In your search for the Duchess' daughter, you've found her severed hand on the island above Cadaver Keep - but you have not picked it up. ##You should go back and obtain the hand.
Chinese: 寻找女公爵女儿的途中，你在尸骸要塞上方的岛上找到了她被切断的手——但你还没有捡起来。##你应该回去把手取走。

English: In your search for the Duchess' daughter, you were only able to recover her severed hand. ##You should return to the Duchess, in her manor on the southern edge of the Endless Realm, to tell her what you've found.
Chinese: 寻找女公爵女儿的途中，你只找回了她被切断的手。##你应该回到无尽领域南缘庄园里的女公爵那里，告诉她你的发现。

English: In recompense for your efforts, the Duchess has granted you a spectral finger. You should speak more with her, to recruit her to your cause.
Chinese: 为酬谢你的努力，女公爵赠你一根幽灵手指。你应该再和她多谈谈，把她招募到你的事业中。

English: You have recruited The Duchess to your cause, and she has relocated to Vela's old fortress - the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 你已把女公爵招募到你的事业中，她已移居薇拉的旧堡垒——炫光要塞。

English: You have recruited The Duchess to your cause, and she's relocated to Vela's old fortress; the Blinding Light. ##You convinced her that, by siding with Vela, the Endless could be granted a true death.
Chinese: 你已把女公爵招募到你的事业中，她已移居薇拉的旧堡垒——炫光要塞。##你说服她相信：站在薇拉一边，无尽者便能获得真正的死亡。

English: You have recruited The Duchess to your cause, and she's relocated to Vela's old fortress; the Blinding Light. ##You convinced her that, by siding with Vela, the Endless spell could be fixed, granting true immortality.
Chinese: 你已把女公爵招募到你的事业中，她已移居薇拉的旧堡垒——炫光要塞。##你说服她相信：站在薇拉一边，无尽咒便能得以修复，赋予真正的永生。

English: You have recruited The Duchess to your cause, and she's relocated to Vela's old fortress; the Blinding Light. ##You convinced her that, by opposing Vela, she could carve out her own future.
Chinese: 你已把女公爵招募到你的事业中，她已移居薇拉的旧堡垒——炫光要塞。##你说服她相信：对抗薇拉，她便能开创属于自己的未来。

English: The Whispers of Ghosts
Chinese: 幽灵的低语

English: You have been visited by a ghost, who seems to have taken an interest in your plight.
Chinese: 一位幽灵造访了你，她似乎对你的困境颇感兴趣。

English: You have been visited by a ghost who claims to have known Vela in her former life. ##She says that if you wish to understand the woman to whom your fate is bound, you should seek a [[destroyed manor]] somewhere on the [[north-eastern edge of Hallowshire]].
Chinese: 一位声称认识薇拉生前点滴的幽灵造访了你。##她说，如果你想读懂这个与你命运相连的女人，就该去[[哈洛郡东北边缘]]某处寻找一座[[被毁的庄园]]。

English: A ghost has promised to reveal Vela's motives. ##You followed her to the [[destroyed manor]] to the [[north-eastern edge of Hallowshire]]; now all that remains is to go inside.
Chinese: 一位幽灵许诺揭示薇拉的动机。##你跟着她来到[[哈洛郡东北边缘]]的[[被毁庄园]]；现在只剩进去了。

English: A ghost has promised to reveal Vela's motives. ##She has asked you to meet her at  an [[Airship Cove]] on the [[western-edge of the Endless Realm]], where she will continue her tale.
Chinese: 一位幽灵许诺揭示薇拉的动机。##她约你在[[无尽领域西缘]]的[[飞艇湾]]见面，继续讲她的故事。

English: A ghost has promised to reveal Vela's motives. ##You followed her to the [[Airship Cove]] on the [[western-edge of the Endless Realm]]; now you should enter and hear what more she has to say.
Chinese: 一位幽灵许诺揭示薇拉的动机。##你跟着她来到[[无尽领域西缘]]的[[飞艇湾]]；现在进去听听她还要说什么。

English: A ghost has promised to reveal Vela's motives. ##She has asked you to meet her at the wreckage of the [[Black Goblin Airship]] which drifts to the [[north-west of the Clockwork Kingdom]].
Chinese: 一位幽灵许诺揭示薇拉的动机。##她约你去[[黑哥布林飞艇]]的残骸见面，那残骸漂浮在[[发条王国西北]]。

English: A ghost has promised to reveal Vela's motives. ##wreckage of the [[Black Goblin Airship]] which drifts to the [[north-west of the Clockwork Kingdom]]; now you should approach her on the ship's bow so she can finish her tale.
Chinese: 一位幽灵许诺揭示薇拉的动机。##地点在漂浮于[[发条王国西北]]的[[黑哥布林飞艇]]残骸；现在去船首找她，听她讲完最后的故事。

English: You were visited by a ghost who knew Vela in her former life. ##She explained to you the history of Vela and the Dark Stars, explaining that Vela is driven by the death of her sister, Isabet.
Chinese: 一位认识薇拉生前的幽灵造访了你。##她向你讲述了薇拉与黑星佣兵团的过往，说薇拉的一切执念皆源于妹妹伊莎贝特之死。

English: An Old Friend
Chinese: 一位故人

English: The High Confessor has asked you to deal with a personal matter. ##There is a small house in the [[western forest of Hallowshire]], which contains a godlet. She has asked you to kill it with a special Void Scalpel.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者请你处理一件私事。##[[哈洛郡西部森林]]里有一座小屋，里面关着一名稚神。她请你用一把特制的虚空手术刀杀死它。

English: The High Confessor has asked you to deal with a personal matter, and slay a certain godlet. ##You travelled to the small house in the [[western forest of Hallowshire]], but a ghost urged you not to carry out the deed.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者请你处理一件私事，杀死某名稚神。##你前往[[哈洛郡西部森林]]的那座小屋，但一位幽灵恳求你不要下手。

English: You carried out a personal matter for the High Confessor by killing her godlet, much to the lamentation of the High Confessor's own ghost; Caer. ##You should return to the High Confessor in the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 你替至高忏悔者处理了私事，杀死了她的稚神，令她自己的幽灵凯尔悲恸不已。##你应该回炫光要塞向至高忏悔者复命。

English: You carried out a personal matter for the High Confessor by killing her godlet, much to the lamentation of the High Confessor's own ghost; Caer.
Chinese: 你替至高忏悔者处理了私事，杀死了她的稚神，令她自己的幽灵凯尔悲恸不已。

English: The High Confessor requested that you kill a godlet, but you refused and broke its shackles instead. The High Confessor's ghost - Caer - was grateful. ##You should return to the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者命你杀死一名稚神，你却拒绝了，还打碎了它的锁链。至高忏悔者的幽灵——凯尔——对你感激不已。##你应该回炫光要塞去。

English: The High Confessor requested that you kill a godlet, but you refused and broke its shackles instead. ##The whole ordeal was a test of loyalty, which the High Confessor failed; and she has been taken away by Inquisition agents. You should speak with the ghost, Caer.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者命你杀死一名稚神，你却拒绝了，还打碎了它的锁链。##原来整场折磨都是一次忠诚考验——而至高忏悔者没能通过；她已被宗教裁判所特务带走。你应该去找幽灵凯尔谈谈。

English: The High Confessor requested that you kill a godlet, but you refused and broke its shackles instead. ##The whole ordeal was a test of loyalty, which the High Confessor failed; and she has been taken away by Inquisition agents.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者命你杀死一名稚神，你却拒绝了，还打碎了它的锁链。##原来整场折磨都是一次忠诚考验——而至高忏悔者没能通过；她已被宗教裁判所特务带走。

English: Damn Fine Tea
Chinese: 好得要命的茶

English: Inquisitor Ignavius has asked you to obtain some [[Scryshroom Tea]] from the region of Pwyll. ##If you wish to indulge him, you should head to [[Pwyll Village]] and attempt to buy some.
Chinese: 伊格纳修斯审判官请你从普威尔地区弄些[[窥菇茶]]来。##若想纵容他这个嗜好，就去[[普威尔村]]试着买一些吧。

English: You obtained some Scryshroom Tea for Inquisitor Ignavius, which he proclaimed was [[damn fine tea.]].##You suddenly have a curious desire to re-read the Dual Crags periodical story by D. Hange.
Chinese: 你为伊格纳修斯审判官弄到了窥菇茶，他盛赞这是[[好得要命的茶]]。##你突然生出一个奇怪的念头：想重读 D. 汉格写的《双峰崖》连载小说。

English: A Simple Delivery
Chinese: 简单的送货

English: A girl has given you a crate of 'Byonne Silks' and asked you to deliver it to the Wobbly Noggin. ##There should be a man named Bardolph in the small room, to the left as you enter.
Chinese: 一个姑娘交给你一箱"拜昂丝绸"，请你送去摇晃酒馆。##进门左手边的小房间里应该有个叫巴道夫的男人。

English: A girl has given you a crate of 'Byonne Silks' and asked you to deliver it to the Wobbly Noggin. ##There should be a man named Bardolph in the small room, to the left as you enter. ##On the way, a guard stopped you and asked to check the crate; but you managed to evade him.
Chinese: 一个姑娘交给你一箱"拜昂丝绸"，请你送去摇晃酒馆。##进门左手边的小房间里应该有个叫巴道夫的男人。##路上，一名卫兵拦下你要检查箱子；但你成功避开了他。

English: A girl has given you a crate of 'Byonne Silks' and asked you to deliver it to the Wobbly Noggin, but a guard confiscated the goods. ##You should still visit Bardolph in the Wobbly Noggin and tell him you lost the delivery.
Chinese: 一个姑娘交给你一箱"拜昂丝绸"，请你送去摇晃酒馆，但半路货被卫兵没收了。##你还是该去摇晃酒馆见见巴道夫，告诉他货弄丢了。

English: You successfully delivered the crate of 'Byonne Silks' to Bardolph in the Wobbly Noggin. ##He said you should visit the Lost Purse sometime; just look for a suspicious skull in an abandoned Hallow building.
Chinese: 你成功把那箱"拜昂丝绸"送到了摇晃酒馆的巴道夫手上。##他说你有空该去失包黑店转转；在哈洛某栋废弃建筑里找一个可疑的骷髅标志就行。

English: You told Bardolph in the Wobbly Noggin that his 'silks' were confiscated. ##He said you should visit the Lost Purse sometime; just look for a suspicious skull in an abandoned Hallow building.
Chinese: 你告诉摇晃酒馆的巴道夫，他的"丝绸"被没收了。##他说你有空该去失包黑店转转；在哈洛某栋废弃建筑里找一个可疑的骷髅标志就行。

English: From Under His Nose
Chinese: 就在他眼皮底下

English: You met up with Innogen at the Lost Purse. You should speak with her again when you're ready for work.
Chinese: 你在失包黑店见到了因诺根。准备好接活时再找她谈谈。

English: Innogen in the Lost Purse has asked you to steal a valuable artefact from Vernon Berwig, of the Winged Merchants Guild. ##His house can be found on the high street, but it has a locked chamber that can only be accessed from outside the property.
Chinese: 失包黑店的因诺根请你从飞翼商会的弗农·伯维格那里偷一件贵重圣物。##他的房子就在大街上，但有一间上锁的密室，只能从屋外进入。

English: You stole an artefact from right under Vernon Berwig's nose. Innogen in the Lost Purse will be interested in this.
Chinese: 你就在弗农·伯维格的眼皮底下偷走了圣物。失包黑店的因诺根会感兴趣的。

English: You stole Vernon Berwig's artefact from right under his nose, and claimed your reward from Innogen in the Lost Purse.
Chinese: 你就在弗农·伯维格的眼皮底下偷走了他的圣物，并从失包黑店的因诺根那里领了报酬。

English: Perchance to Dream
Chinese: 也许会做梦

English: You met a peculiar man, haunted by dreams. He asked you to find his lost journal. ##You should enquire further as to where it could be.
Chinese: 你遇到一个古怪的男人，被梦魇纠缠。他请你找回他丢失的日记。##你该多打听打听它可能在哪儿。

English: You met a peculiar man, haunted by dreams. He asked you to find his lost journal. ##He thinks it was stolen by goblins in the mountains, to the east of the nearby fortress.
Chinese: 你遇到一个古怪的男人，被梦魇纠缠。他请你找回他丢失的日记。##他认为是附近堡垒东面山中的哥布林偷走了它。

English: You found a journal filled with dreams. You should return it to its original owner.
Chinese: 你找到一本写满梦境的日记。应该把它物归原主。

English: You returned the dream journal to its owner.
Chinese: 你把梦境日记还给了它的主人。

English: The Golden Typhos
Chinese: 黄金热瘴号

English: You heard the head of the Winged Merchants Guild is looking for adventurers. You should visit the house in Hallow with an airship sign.
Chinese: 你听说飞翼商会的会长正在寻找冒险者。你应该去哈洛那栋挂着飞艇招牌的房子看看。

English: Vernon Berwig, head of the Winged Merchants Guild, has tasked you with tracking down his lost cargo. ##You should keep a lookout for his merchant vessel, the Golden Typhos.
Chinese: 飞翼商会会长弗农·伯维格交给你一个任务：追踪他失踪的货物。##你应该留意他的商船"黄金热瘴号"。

English: You boarded the Golden Typhos ship and found a peculiar artifact in its hold.##You should visit the [[Winged Merchants Guild]] in Hallow.
Chinese: 你登上了黄金热瘴号，在货舱里发现一件奇特的圣物。##你应该去哈洛的[[飞翼商会]]走一趟。

English: You  returned the lost artifact to Vernon Berwig in the Winged Merchants Guild. He asked you to return in a day to collect your reward.
Chinese: 你把失窃的圣物还给了飞翼商会的弗农·伯维格。他要你一天后再来领取报酬。

English: You  returned the lost artifact to Vernon Berwig in the Winged Merchants Guild. He asked you to return in a day to collect your reward.
Chinese: 你把失窃的圣物还给了飞翼商会的弗农·伯维格。他要你一天后再来领取报酬。

English: You returned to Vernon Berwig for your reward, but he was dead - his corpse unnaturally shrivelled. The thing is clearly cursed; you should be grateful to have avoided the same fate.
Chinese: 你回去找弗农·伯维格领报酬，他却已经死了——尸体干瘪得不自然。那东西显然受了诅咒；你该庆幸自己逃过一劫。

English: The God Hunt
Chinese: 猎神行动

English: The Apostatic Union seek to purge cultists and god worshippers from the realm of Hallowshire. ##Visit the Union council building, in the centre of Hallow town, to learn more.
Chinese: 叛教联盟想要肃清哈洛郡的邪教徒和神明崇拜者。##去哈洛镇中心的联盟议会大楼了解更多。

English: The Apostatic Union seek to purge cultists and god worshippers from the realm of Hallowshire. ##The Polymath in Hallow town has requested your aid. She suggests you enquire further in the farmlands to the northeast of Hallow.
Chinese: 叛教联盟想要肃清哈洛郡的邪教徒和神明崇拜者。##哈洛镇的博学家请求你的援助。她建议你去哈洛东北的农田里再打听打听。

English: The Apostatic Union seek to purge cultists and god worshippers from the realm of Hallowshire. ##You have learned there is a cultist presence in an old belltower, somewhere in the Hallowshire region.
Chinese: 叛教联盟想要肃清哈洛郡的邪教徒和神明崇拜者。##你得知哈洛郡某处的一座旧钟楼里盘踞着邪教徒。

English: The Apostatic Union seek to purge cultists and god worshippers from the realm of Hallowshire. ##You have learned there is a cultist presence in an old belltower, in the forest to the west of Hallowshire.
Chinese: 叛教联盟想要肃清哈洛郡的邪教徒和神明崇拜者。##你得知哈洛郡西面森林里的一座旧钟楼中盘踞着邪教徒。

English: The Apostatic Union seek to purge cultists and god worshippers from the realm of Hallowshire. ##You have discovered a cultist lair and spoken with a Fertile One. To infiltrate further, a tribute of Mushroom Wine must be given.
Chinese: 叛教联盟想要肃清哈洛郡的邪教徒和神明崇拜者。##你发现了邪教徒的巢穴，并与一位育生者谈过话。想继续渗透，必须献上菇酒作贡品。

English: The Apostatic Union seek to purge cultists and god worshippers from the realm of Hallowshire. ##You have gained the Key of Paeguth. It unlocks a cave beneath Hallow Castle, in the east of Hallowshire
Chinese: 叛教联盟想要肃清哈洛郡的邪教徒和神明崇拜者。##你拿到了帕古斯之钥。它能打开哈洛郡东部哈洛城堡下方的洞穴

English: You have spoken with the god Paeguth, who has given you an aspect of itself.##If you wish to help Paeguth, place this aspect at the highest point in the Union's council building in Hallow. ##Alternatively, hand the aspect over to the Union's Polymath to help them defeat the god.
Chinese: 你与神明帕古斯交谈过，它把自身的一面相交给了你。##若想帮助帕古斯，就把这面相安放在哈洛联盟议会大楼的最高处。##或者，把面相交给联盟博学家，帮助他们击败这位神明。

English: You helped the Apostatic Union to defeat the god Paeguth, by obtaining an aspect of the god.## The Union should have no trouble stamping out god worship in the region - though whether this will end the famine, remains to be seen.
Chinese: 你取得神明的面相，帮助叛教联盟击败了帕古斯。##联盟在这片地区扑灭神明崇拜应不成问题——只是这能否终结饥荒，还很难说。

English: You concealed the aspect of Paeguth in Hallow. It will bestow a curse on those nearby, allowing the cult of Paeguth to operate unhindered.## You should seek out Paeguth, who may wish to reward you. You feel a dread presence; they are close to you, right now.
Chinese: 你把帕古斯的面相藏在了哈洛。它将诅咒附近的人们，让帕古斯教团畅通无阻地活动。##你应该去寻找帕古斯，它或许想赏赐你。你感到一阵可怖的存在感——它们就在你身边，此刻。

English: You concealed the aspect of Paeguth in Hallow. It will bestow a curse on those nearby, allowing the cult of Paeguth to operate unhindered. ##The famine will be brought to an end, but at a cost: those who benefit from Paeguth often bear terrible mutations...
Chinese: 你把帕古斯的面相藏在了哈洛。它将诅咒附近的人们，让帕古斯教团畅通无阻地活动。##饥荒将会终结，但代价是：受帕古斯恩惠的人往往带着可怕的变异……

English: A Castle, Cursed
Chinese: 受诅的城堡

English: In the shadow of Hallowshire's castle, you met a frightened peasant. They acted strangely and warned you of the place. Something is clearly amiss.
Chinese: 在哈洛郡城堡的阴影下，你遇到一个惊恐的农夫。他举止怪异，还警告你离那地方远点。显然有什么不对劲。

English: You've heard that a Wikkan priest hides somewhere in Hallowshire's castle keep, and could have something to do with the castle's downfall.
Chinese: 你听说一位维坎祭司藏在哈洛郡城堡主楼的某个地方，城堡的沦落也许与他有关。

English: You spoke to the Wikkan priest in Hallowshire's castle keep. ##He revealed that a curse afflicts the castle; only a sacrifice can present it. There is a sacrificial poison in a secret room, behind a painting.
Chinese: 你与哈洛郡城堡主楼里的维坎祭司谈过。##他透露一道诅咒正折磨着城堡；唯有献祭才能阻止它。某幅画作后面的密室里藏着一瓶献祭之毒。

English: You obtained a sacrificial poison from the secret room in Hallowshire's castle. ##This might be the key to solving the castle's curse; perhaps the nearby Wikkan priest knows what to do with it.
Chinese: 你从哈洛郡城堡的密室里取得了献祭之毒。##这也许是解开城堡诅咒的关键；也许附近的维坎祭司知道该怎么用它。

English: The Duke of Hallowshire drank a second dose of sacrificial poison, killing himself instantly. ##Thus Paeguth's contract-spell has been broken. The castle and the surrounding village will return to normal - but the plague may return as well.
Chinese: 哈洛公爵喝下第二剂献祭之毒，当场身亡。##帕古斯的契约咒就此破除。城堡和周围的村庄将恢复正常——但瘟疫也可能卷土重来。

English: The Duke's son chose to sacrifice himself to renew Paeguth's contract-spell. ##With the spell renewed, the abhorrent strangeness afflicting the castle may subside... but both the Duke and his son are wracked with perpetual agony.
Chinese: 公爵之子选择献祭自己，续上帕古斯的契约咒。##咒约重续之后，纠缠城堡的骇人怪事或将平息……但公爵与他的儿子都将永陷无边的痛苦煎熬。

English: All Good Things...
Chinese: 一切好事……

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes, and you've heard whispers that an entity known as the Entombed One is causing them. ##The Entombed One is said to be locked away below the Castle of Ribs, in the town of Sepulchre. Someone in the castle might know more.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭，你听到传言说，是一个名叫墓中人的存在在作祟。##据说墓中人被锁在陵墓城肋骨城堡的地下。城堡里的人也许知道更多。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes, and you've heard whispers that an entity known as the Entombed One is causing them. ##You spoke to the Queen of Silver, who believes the Entombed One to be her father. She mentioned that Seneschal has the key to unlock the castle's crypt.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭，你听到传言说，是一个名叫墓中人的存在在作祟。##你与白银女王谈过，她相信墓中人就是她的父亲。她提到总管持有打开城堡地宫的钥匙。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes, and you've heard whispers that an entity known as the Entombed One is causing them. ##The Seneschal believes the Entombed One to be the lingering spirit of the Hooded King, trapped in the Castle of Ribs' crypt. He's given you the key; the door resides far below Sepulchre.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭，你听到传言说，是一个名叫墓中人的存在在作祟。##总管相信墓中人便是兜帽王挥之不去的亡灵，被困在肋骨城堡的地宫里。他已把钥匙交给你；那扇门在陵墓城很深很深的地下。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes. It's said that the Entombed One - trapped in the Castle of Ribs' crypts - is causing them. ##The crypts are guarded by a fanged door, which only permits entry to those loyal to the Hooded King. You should ask the Seneschal about this.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭。据说困于肋骨城堡地宫的墓中人正是罪魁祸首。##地宫由一扇獠牙之门把守，只放忠于兜帽王的人进入。你应该向总管问问此事。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes. It's said that the Entombed One - trapped in the Castle of Ribs' crypts - is causing them. ##The crypts are guarded by a fanged door. To bypass it, the Seneschal has told you to find someone who's still loyal to the Hooded King, and convince them to give you their blood.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭。据说困于肋骨城堡地宫的墓中人正是罪魁祸首。##地宫由一扇獠牙之门把守。总管告诉你，想绕过它，就得找到一个仍忠于兜帽王的人，说服对方献出鲜血。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes. It's said that the Entombed One - trapped in the Castle of Ribs' crypts - is causing them. ##The crypts are guarded by a fanged door. You've obtained a sample of blood that should allow you to pass.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭。据说困于肋骨城堡地宫的墓中人正是罪魁祸首。##地宫由一扇獠牙之门把守。你已取得一份血液样本，应该能让你通过。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes. It's said that the Entombed One - trapped in the Castle of Ribs' crypts - is causing them. ##You've bypassed the door that seals the castle crypts. All that remains is to confront whatever's down there.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭。据说困于肋骨城堡地宫的墓中人正是罪魁祸首。##你已绕过封锁城堡地宫的门。剩下的就是下去面对里面的东西。

English: The lands of the Endless are beset with earthquakes. You've discovered that a trauma ghost of the Queen of Silver is causing them, and that this 'Entombed One' plans to destroy the whole island. ##The Queen of Silver will surely want to know about this.
Chinese: 无尽者的领地频遭地震侵袭。你发现作祟的是白银女王的一道创伤幽灵，而这个"墓中人"打算毁掉整座岛屿。##白银女王一定想知道这件事。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Endless.##The Queen has given you a necklace. She hopes it will remind the ghost of her duty to her kingdom, and stop her from destroying the island. ##Though perhaps you could help the Entombed One instead; and finally give the Endless an ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽者。##女王把一条项链交给你。她希望这能让幽灵想起自己对王国的职责，停止毁灭岛屿。##不过，你也可以选择帮墓中人一把；让无尽者终于迎来他们的终结。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Endless.##Penitent Thaw has given you a potion of happy memories, in the hope of dissuading the Entombed One from destroying the island. ##Though perhaps you could help the Entombed One instead; and finally give the Endless an ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽者。##忏悔者·索给了你一瓶至乐记忆，希望借此劝阻墓中人毁灭岛屿。##不过，你也可以选择帮墓中人一把；让无尽者终于迎来他们的终结。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Endless.##The Queen has given you a necklace, to remind the Entombed One of her duty. Penitent Thaw has also given you a vial of happy memories. One of these items could help to dissuade the ghost from destruction. ##Though perhaps you could help the Entombed One instead; and finally give the Endless an ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽者。##女王给了你一条项链，想让墓中人记起自己的职责。忏悔者·索也给了你一瓶至乐记忆。这两件东西或许都能劝阻幽灵，让她放弃毁灭。##不过，你也可以选择帮墓中人一把；让无尽者终于迎来他们的终结。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Endless.##Penitent Thaw has given you a vial of happy memories. The Queen has also given you a necklace, to remind the Entombed One of her duty. One of these items could help to dissuade the ghost from destruction.##Though perhaps you could help the Entombed One instead; and finally give the Endless an ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽者。##忏悔者·索给了你一瓶至乐记忆。女王也给了你一条项链，想让墓中人记起自己的职责。这两件东西或许都能劝阻幽灵，让她放弃毁灭。##不过，你也可以选择帮墓中人一把；让无尽者终于迎来他们的终结。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Endless.## You gave the Queen's necklace to the ghost, but it failed to quell her anger. If you can't charm the ghost yourself, there must be another Endless denizen who can help. ##Though perhaps you could help the Entombed One instead; and finally give the Endless an ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽者。##你把女王的项链交给了幽灵，却没能平息她的怒火。若你自己无法魅惑幽灵，一定还有别的无尽者居民能帮忙。##不过，你也可以选择帮墓中人一把；让无尽者终于迎来他们的终结。

English: The Entombed One is a ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Endless.## You gave the Queen's necklace to the ghost, but it failed to quell her anger. If you can't charm the ghost yourself, Penitent Thaw's vial of memories could work.##Though perhaps you could help the Entombed One instead; and finally give the Endless an ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽者。##你把女王的项链交给了幽灵，却没能平息她的怒火。若你自己无法魅惑幽灵，忏悔者·索的记忆瓶也许管用。##不过，你也可以选择帮墓中人一把；让无尽者终于迎来他们的终结。

English: You managed to dissuade the Entombed One from destroying the Kingdom of the Endless.##You should tell the Queen of Silver, and put the matter to rest.
Chinese: 你成功劝阻了墓中人，让她放弃毁灭无尽王国。##你应该告诉白银女王，让这件事就此了结。

English: You managed to dissuade the Entombed One from destroying the Kingdom of the Endless.##The Queen of Silver thanked you for your efforts; it seems the story of the Endless will not be concluding just yet.
Chinese: 你成功劝阻了墓中人，让她放弃毁灭无尽王国。##白银女王感谢了你的努力；看来无尽者的故事还不会就此落幕。

English: The Entombed One is a trauma ghost of the Queen of Silver, and she plans to destroy the Kingdom of the Endless.##You managed to trick the Queen into paying her ghost a visit. You should rest and return to the castle later, to witness the aftermath.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的创伤幽灵，她打算毁灭无尽王国。##你设法骗女王去见了她的幽灵。你该休息一下，稍后回城堡看看结果如何。

English: The Entombed One is a trauma ghost of the Queen of Silver, and with your help, she overthrew the Queen and progressed her plans to destroy the Kingdom of the Endless.##The seed of destruction has been planted. In time, the Endless will finally have their ending.
Chinese: 墓中人是白银女王的创伤幽灵，在你的帮助下，她推翻了女王，推进了毁灭无尽王国的计划。##毁灭的种子已经种下。假以时日，无尽者终将迎来他们的终结。

English: The Ethics of Eating Flesh
Chinese: 食肉的伦理

English: A huge vat of meat - grown to feed the Endless - has developed sentience. It spoke with you, pleading for its freedom. ##A caretaker was lurking nearby. Perhaps you should speak with them about this.
Chinese: 一大缸为供养无尽者而培植的血肉产生了自我意识。它向你倾诉，哀求自由。##一名看守就在附近徘徊。也许你该找他谈谈这件事。

English: A huge vat of meat - grown to feed the Endless - has developed sentience. It spoke with you, pleading for its freedom. ##You spoke with Maggotson about the matter, and he told you to visit Penitent Thaw above the flesh-farm.
Chinese: 一大缸为供养无尽者而培植的血肉产生了自我意识。它向你倾诉，哀求自由。##你与马戈特森谈过此事，他让你去血肉农场上方找忏悔者·索。

English: A huge vat of meat - grown to feed the Endless - has developed sentience. It spoke with you, pleading for its freedom. ##Penitent Thaw urged you to keep this secret. Maggoston is the only one who knows, so you should check on his whereabouts.
Chinese: 一大缸为供养无尽者而培植的血肉产生了自我意识。它向你倾诉，哀求自由。##忏悔者·索恳请你保守这个秘密。马戈特森是唯一知情的人，你应该查查他的下落。

English: Maggotson has disappeared. You notice traces of blood on the floor...##This could be Lord Rhydder's doing. You should visit his estate, on the cliffs to the south-west of Sepuchre.
Chinese: 马戈特森失踪了。你注意到地板上有血迹……##这可能是里德尔勋爵干的。你应该去陵墓城西南悬崖上的他的庄园看看。

English: You found Maggotson at Lord Rhydder's estate. He's been tortured.##If Lord Rhydder knows the flesh-farm has become self aware, he could start another war. You should speak to him at his estate.
Chinese: 你在里德尔勋爵的庄园找到了马戈特森。他遭受了酷刑。##若让里德尔勋爵知道血肉农场产生了自我意识，他可能再启战端。你应该去他的庄园找他谈谈。

English: Lord Rhydder knows the flesh-farm is self aware. Seeing as it is no longer an ethical food source, Rhydder plans to start another war against the living. ##You should speak to Penitent Thaw about this.
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵已经知道血肉农场有了自我意识。既然它不再是合乎伦理的食物来源，里德尔便打算再次对活人开战。##你应该和忏悔者·索谈谈这件事。

English: Lord Rhydder knows the flesh-farm is self aware. Seeing as it is no longer an ethical food source, Rhydder plans to start another war against the living.##Penitent Thaw has given you the means to destroy the flesh-farm. You should return to the flesh-farm itself, and make a decision: kill, or spare it?
Chinese: 里德尔勋爵已经知道血肉农场有了自我意识。既然它不再是合乎伦理的食物来源，里德尔便打算再次对活人开战。##忏悔者·索把摧毁血肉农场的手段交给了你。回到血肉农场，做个决定：杀，还是饶它一命？

English: You spared the life of the sentient flesh-farm.##You should return to Penitent Thaw and tell her of what you've done.
Chinese: 你饶了有自我意识的血肉农场一命。##你应该回忏悔者·索那里，告诉她你的决定。

English: You spared the life of the sentient flesh-farm. Thaw seems intent to keep it alive, so long as it proves a useful test subject. ##However, seeing as it's no longer a source of ethical food, Lord Rhydder will surely lead the Endless into another war against the living to feed.
Chinese: 你饶了有自我意识的血肉农场一命。只要它还能派上试验用场，索似乎就打算让它活下去。##然而，它既然不再是合乎伦理的食物来源，里德尔勋爵必定会带着无尽者再启战端，猎食活人。

English: You destroyed the sentient flesh-farm.##You should return to Penitent Thaw and tell her of what you've done.
Chinese: 你摧毁了有自我意识的血肉农场。##你应该回忏悔者·索那里，告诉她你的所作所为。

English: You destroyed the sentient flesh-farm.##But with the ethics of eating flesh assured, Lord Rhydder will have no grounds to stoke tensions further.
Chinese: 你摧毁了有自我意识的血肉农场。##不过，食肉伦理既已保全，里德尔勋爵便没有借口继续煽动紧张局势了。

English: A Morbid Appetite
Chinese: 病态的胃口

English: You encountered a catacomb wyrm that harboured a consciousness, formed from the minds of its victims. ##They asked you to recover three Urns of Anguish, which are scattered around the Kingdom of the Endless.
Chinese: 你遇到一条怀有意识的墓穴蠕虫——那意识由受害者的心智凝聚而成。##它请你找回三只悲恸之瓮，它们散落在无尽王国各处。

English: You encountered a catacomb wyrm that harboured a consciousness, formed from the minds of its victims. ##You have found an Urn of Anguish, but you will need to bring all three to the wyrm.
Chinese: 你遇到一条怀有意识的墓穴蠕虫——那意识由受害者的心智凝聚而成。##你已找到一只悲恸之瓮，但需要把三只全部带给蠕虫。

English: You encountered a catacomb wyrm that harboured a consciousness, formed from the minds of its victims. ##You brought it three Urns of Anguish, which satiated its hunger. It will not trouble the mausoleums for a good while.
Chinese: 你遇到一条怀有意识的墓穴蠕虫——那意识由受害者的心智凝聚而成。##你带来三只悲恸之瓮，喂饱了它的饥渴。好一段时间里它不会再叨扰那些陵墓了。

English: Hallowshire Cartography
Chinese: 哈洛郡制图

English: A scholar has asked you to locate four landmarks in Hallowshire, and mark them by equipping and using your Cartography Notebook: ##In the centre is Hallow Clocktower; to the east, the largest farmstead; to the west, a ruin entwined with a tree; to the south, the point at which the river forks.
Chinese: 一位学者请你在哈洛郡找到四处地标，装备并使用制图笔记将它们标记下来：##中央是哈洛钟楼；东面是最大的农庄；西面是一座与树缠绕的遗迹；南面是河流的分叉点。

English: A scholar has asked you to locate four landmarks in Hallowshire. You have found and marked them all in your notebook; be sure to return to the scholar to receive your reward.
Chinese: 一位学者请你在哈洛郡找到四处地标。你已全部找到并在笔记中标记；记得回学者那里领取奖励。

English: You successfully located all four Hallowshire landmarks for the scholar. Your journal has been updated with the Academy's magic map of the region.
Chinese: 你成功为学者找齐了哈洛郡的四处地标。你的日志已更新，收录了学院的这一地区魔法地图。

English: Special Cartography
Chinese: 特殊制图

English: ----LIST OF PLACES
Chinese: ----LIST OF PLACES

English: ----MAP COMPLETE. TRIGGER THIS IN CODE, NOT DIALOGUE
Chinese: ----MAP COMPLETE. TRIGGER THIS IN CODE, NOT DIALOGUE

English: Flying High
Chinese: 一飞冲天

English: A huge island floats above Hallowshire. You have heard rumours that this is the Erudite Academy; a travelling bastion of scholarly pursuits, that will only grant access to a chosen few.
Chinese: 一座巨岛悬浮在哈洛郡上空。你听到传言，说这就是博识学院——一座漂游的学术堡垒，只放少数天之骄子入内。

English: A huge island floats above Hallowshire. You have heard rumours that this is the Erudite Academy; a travelling bastion of scholarly pursuits. ##Apparently, you can be granted access if an Academy scholar gives you a letter of recommendation.
Chinese: 一座巨岛悬浮在哈洛郡上空。你听到传言，说这就是博识学院——一座漂游的学术堡垒。##据说，只要学院学者给你一封推荐信，你便可获准入内。

English: A huge island floats above Hallowshire. You have heard rumours that this is the Erudite Academy; a travelling bastion of scholarly pursuits. ##An Academy scholar has offered to grant you access if you bring them enough cartography charts.
Chinese: 一座巨岛悬浮在哈洛郡上空。你听到传言，说这就是博识学院——一座漂游的学术堡垒。##一位学院学者许诺，只要你带来足够多的制图海图，便可放你入内。

English: A huge island floats above Hallowshire. You have heard rumours that this is the Erudite Academy; a travelling bastion of scholarly pursuits. ##You have been given a letter of recommendation that should allow access.
Chinese: 一座巨岛悬浮在哈洛郡上空。你听到传言，说这就是博识学院——一座漂游的学术堡垒。##你已拿到一封推荐信，凭它应该能入内。

English: You have gained access to the Erudite Academy; a travelling bastion of scholarly pursuits. Now, what secrets are hidden in the most acclaimed institution of the Apostatic Union?
Chinese: 你已进入博识学院——一座漂游的学术堡垒。现在，这座叛教联盟最负盛名的学府里，究竟藏着什么秘密？

English: A Divine Captive
Chinese: 神明的囚徒

English: In the Erudite Academy, an Inquisition agent has asked you to help her find an illegal god. ##She claims one of the scholars must be concealing it somewhere; you should ask around for more information.
Chinese: 在博识学院，一名宗教裁判所特务请你帮忙寻找一位非法神明。##她声称必有一名学者把它藏在了某处；你应该四处打听更多消息。

English: In the Erudite Academy, an Inquisition agent has asked you to help her find an illegal god. ##Most of the scholars just seem to bicker amongst themselves, but there must be someone who has seen something untoward.
Chinese: 在博识学院，一名宗教裁判所特务请你帮忙寻找一位非法神明。##大多数学者似乎只会互相斗嘴，但肯定有人见过什么不对劲的事。

English: In the Erudite Academy, an Inquisition agent has asked you to help her find an illegal god. ##Ghlem, the Academy historian, claims to have seen someone coming and going into the basement below her building. Apparently candlesticks are the key to unlocking this secret passage.
Chinese: 在博识学院，一名宗教裁判所特务请你帮忙寻找一位非法神明。##学院历史学家格莱姆声称，看见有人频繁出入她那栋楼下的地下室。据说烛台是开启这条密道的钥匙。

English: You entered a secret chamber in the Erudite Academy, which contains a captive god. ##After a little rooting around, you also found a journal belonging to Jerome Verrier, the Head Aetherist of the Academy. ##You could confront Jerome at the observatory tower, or take the evidence straight to the Inquisitor who is lurking around the Academy.
Chinese: 你进入了博识学院的一间密室，里面囚禁着一位神明。##一番翻找之后，你还发现了一本属于学院首席乙太师杰罗姆·维里耶的日志。##你可以去观星塔与杰罗姆当面对质，也可以把罪证直接交给在学院附近徘徊的审判官。

English: You entered a secret chamber in the Erudite Academy, which contains a captive god. ##You also found a journal belonging to Jerome Verrier, the Head Aetherist of the Academy. You returned this journal to Jerome, saving the Academy from the Inquisition's wrath.
Chinese: 你进入了博识学院的一间密室，里面囚禁着一位神明。##你还发现了一本属于学院首席乙太师杰罗姆·维里耶的日志，并把它还给了杰罗姆，让学院免遭宗教裁判所的雷霆之怒。

English: You entered a secret chamber in the Erudite Academy, which contains a captive god. ##You also found a journal belonging to Jerome Verrier, the Head Aetherist of the Academy. You gave this evidence to the Inquisition, condemning the academy to their wrath.
Chinese: 你进入了博识学院的一间密室，里面囚禁着一位神明。##你还发现了一本属于学院首席乙太师杰罗姆·维里耶的日志，并把这份罪证交给了宗教裁判所，将学院送入了他们的雷霆之怒。

English: We Don't Need Roads
Chinese: 我们不需要道路

English: Natalya, the Chief Engineer of the Erudite Academy, has asked you to link three Academy Portals using the key she gave you. ##The first is in the Academy itself; while the other two are somewhere in the Clockwork Kingdom and the Endless Realm respectively. There may be other portals to find, but she wants these three specifically.
Chinese: 博识学院首席工程师娜塔莉亚请你用她给的钥匙连接三座学院传送门。##第一座就在学院里；另外两座分别位于发条王国和无尽领域的某处。或许还有别的传送门可找，但她要的就是这三座。

English: Natalya, the Chief Engineer of the Erudite Academy, has asked you to link three Academy Portals using the key she gave you. ##You have activated all three portals she asked for, and you should return to her in the Academy for your reward.
Chinese: 博识学院首席工程师娜塔莉亚请你用她给的钥匙连接三座学院传送门。##你已激活她要求的全部三座传送门，回学院找她领取奖励吧。

English: Natalya, the Chief Engineer of the Erudite Academy, asked you to link three Academy Portals. ##You did as she asked, allowing for instantaneous travel between the three main islands in the Oneiric Isles. There may be even more Academy Portals to discover, however.
Chinese: 博识学院首席工程师娜塔莉亚请你连接三座学院传送门。##你照她说的做了，梦幻群岛三大主岛之间从此可以瞬间往来。不过，或许还有更多学院传送门等待发现。

English: Bottled Visions
Chinese: 瓶装幻象

English: You met Bina, a refugee from the Clockwork Kingdom travelling through Hallowshire. It seems as if her husband, Youssef, could use some help.
Chinese: 你遇见了宾娜，一位途经哈洛郡的发条王国难民。她的丈夫优素福似乎需要些帮助。

English: Youssef, a Clockwork Kingdom refugee in Hallowshire, has asked you to recover a bottled vision intended for his sister Yasmeen. ##It’s most likely in a nearby deserter camp, stashed in an old tower.
Chinese: 哈洛郡的发条王国难民优素福请你找回一瓶装给他妹妹亚斯敏的瓶装幻象。##它多半就在附近的逃兵营地，藏在某座旧塔里。

English: Youssef, a Clockwork Kingdom refugee in Hallowshire, has asked you to recover a bottled vision intended for his sister Yasmeen. ##You recovered the bottle, and now Youssef has asked you to take it to Mikhail the smuggler – on the eastern edge of Hallowshire.
Chinese: 哈洛郡的发条王国难民优素福请你找回一瓶装给他妹妹亚斯敏的瓶装幻象。##瓶子已找回，如今优素福请你把它送到走私贩米哈伊尔那里——就在哈洛郡东缘。

English: You successfully delivered Youssef’s bottled vision to Mikhail the smuggler, who promised to make sure it reached Youssef’s sister Yasmeen inside the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 你成功把优素福的瓶装幻象交给了走私贩米哈伊尔，他保证一定送到发条王国境内优素福的妹妹亚斯敏手上。

English: You successfully delivered Youssef's bottled vision to Mikhail the smuggler, but did not ask him to pass it on to Youssef's sister Yasmeen – instead pocketing the profit for yourself.
Chinese: 你成功把优素福的瓶装幻象交给了走私贩米哈伊尔，却没让他转交给优素福的妹妹亚斯敏——而是把好处揣进了自己腰包。

English: Thornwood Manor
Chinese: 荆棘木庄园

English: You have heard that Thornwood Manor, a two hundred year old estate, is up for sale. ##Visit the Apostatic Union council building in Hallow Town for more information.
Chinese: 你听说有着两百年历史的庄园——荆棘木庄园——正在出售。##去哈洛镇的叛教联盟议会大楼了解详情。

English: You have heard that Thornwood Manor, a two hundred year old estate, is up for sale. ##The Apostatic Union council clerk in Hallow Town will sell it for 200 coin, though it will cost considerably more to refurbish the manor to its former glory.
Chinese: 你听说有着两百年历史的庄园——荆棘木庄园——正在出售。##哈洛镇的联盟议会书记员开价 200 硬币，不过要把它修葺回昔日荣光，花费可远不止这些。

English: You have purchased Thornwood Manor (and its accompanying island), which floats just off the southern edge of Hallowshire, accessible by a lift. ##The manor needs considerable renovations; use a Property Station at Hallow Town council, or on the estate itself, to upgrade it.
Chinese: 你已买下荆棘木庄园（连同附属岛屿），它就悬在哈洛郡南缘附近，可乘升降机抵达。##庄园亟需大规模整修；使用哈洛镇议会处或庄园里的房产工作站进行升级。

English: You have purchased Thornwood Manor, but when resting in the master bedroom you often have strange dreams and wake to find blood on your pillow.
Chinese: 你已买下荆棘木庄园，但在主卧休息时你常常做怪梦，醒来发现枕头上沾着血。

English: You have purchased Thornwood Manor and spoken to the caretaker who tends the grounds. He has warned you that the Manor's previous owner - one of the Thornwood family - may still be alive, and he has compelled you to stay out of the basement...
Chinese: 你已买下荆棘木庄园，并与照看庄园的看守谈过。他警告你，庄园的前任主人——荆棘木家的一员——可能还活着，并再三叮嘱你别进地下室……

English: You have purchased Thornwood Manor, but when resting in the master bedroom you often have strange dreams and wake to find blood on your pillow. ##Meanwhile, the caretaker has compelled you to stay out of the basement...
Chinese: 你已买下荆棘木庄园，但在主卧休息时你常常做怪梦，醒来发现枕头上沾着血。##与此同时，看守也再三叮嘱你别进地下室……

English: In the basement of Thornwood Manor you have found a peculiar and haunting statue. It seems to be missing several items; perhaps completing the statue will have some effect.
Chinese: 你在荆棘木庄园的地下室发现了一尊古怪而萦绕人心的雕像。它似乎缺了几样部件；也许补全雕像会有什么效果。

English: In the basement of Thornwood Manor you have found a peculiar and haunting statue. Replacing its missing items has revealed a secret passage underground. You should explore further...
Chinese: 你在荆棘木庄园的地下室发现了一尊古怪而萦绕人心的雕像。补上缺失的部件后，一条地下密道显露了出来。你应该继续探索……

English: In the basement of Thornwood Manor there is a vierme, who feeds upon dreams. ##She is bound to the estate grounds by some spell, and in order to break it, you must recover a spellbook from a ruined house in Hallowshire's western forest. ##Of course, you could also try and rid the manor of her presence through more... violent means.
Chinese: 荆棘木庄园的地下室里住着一只以梦为食的维尔姆。##某种咒语将她束缚在庄园之内；要破除它，你必须从哈洛郡西部森林一座破败的房子里取回一本法术书。##当然，你也可以用更……暴力的手段请她离开。

English: In the basement of Thornwood Manor there is a vierme, who feeds upon dreams. ##She is bound to the estate grounds by some spell, but you have recovered a spellbook that may release her.
Chinese: 荆棘木庄园的地下室里住着一只以梦为食的维尔姆。##某种咒语将她束缚在庄园之内，而你已取回那本或许能解救她的法术书。

English: You have freed the vierme who dwells in the basement of Thornwood Manor. She will live there still, but promises to grant you invigorating dreams when she feeds on you in the night.
Chinese: 你解放了住在荆棘木庄园地下室的维尔姆。她仍会住在那里，但许诺夜里进食时会赠你振奋精神的美梦。

English: In the basement of Thornwood Manor there is a vierme, who feeds upon dreams. ##You have attacked her, and she is now hostile to you. Perhaps you should finish the job and grant her eternal rest at last.
Chinese: 荆棘木庄园的地下室里住着一只以梦为食的维尔姆。##你袭击了她，如今她对你充满敌意。也许你该把事情做绝，让她终于得到永恒的安息。

English: You have killed the vierme who dwelled in the basement of Thornwood Manor. You may now rest soundly in your bed, no longer fearful of bumps in the night.
Chinese: 你杀死了住在荆棘木庄园地下室的维尔姆。如今你可以安枕无忧，夜里再有动静也不必惊慌。

English: Below the Endless
Chinese: 无尽之下

English: A noble has asked you to investigate his mines, in the South-West of the Endless Region.
Chinese: 一位贵族请你调查他在无尽领域西南部的矿坑。

English: You encountered a man who is tortured by crystals which grow from his flesh in the South-West of the Endless Region. ##It all seems to relate to the nearby mines...
Chinese: 你在无尽领域西南部遇见一个男人，从他血肉中生长出的水晶正折磨着他。##这一切似乎都与附近的矿坑有关……

English: You have discovered a religious group in the mines in the South-West of the Endless Region.##The followers make reference to a crystal goddess deeper in the mine...
Chinese: 你在无尽领域西南部的矿坑里发现了一个宗教团体。##信徒们提到了矿坑深处的一位水晶女神……

English: You have found the statue of the crystal goddess deep in Endless Mines.##Will you pledge your faith? Or will you find a way to destroy it?
Chinese: 你在无尽矿坑深处找到了水晶女神的雕像。##你要献上信仰？还是想办法毁掉它？

English: You have been given a device capable of killing the fledgling Crystal Goddess, who resides deep in Endless Mines.##But will you use it? Or are you called to join with Her instead?
Chinese: 你得到了一件能杀死深居无尽矿坑的稚嫩水晶女神的装置。##但你会用它吗？还是说，祂在召唤你加入祂？

English: You have sworn yourself to the crystal goddess. By your actions, she will bloom.
Chinese: 你已向水晶女神宣誓效忠。因你的作为，她将绽放。

English: You have destroyed the crystal goddess, and scattered her followers.##The mines' original owner will likely reward you for returning control to him.
Chinese: 你毁灭了水晶女神，打散了她的信徒。##矿坑的原主人大概率会为收回控制权而酬谢你。

English: You have destroyed the crystal goddess, and scattered her followers.##The mines' owner plans to return her to operation soon.
Chinese: 你毁灭了水晶女神，打散了她的信徒。##矿坑主人打算很快让矿坑恢复运转。

English: Safe Passage
Chinese: 安全通行

English: The Clockwork Kingdom has closed its borders, and visitors are strictly forbidden. Your Apostatic Union passport is no good here, scum. ##But perhaps there's someone who can sneak you inside? Try searching Hallowshire's north-eastern coastline for another route.
Chinese: 发条王国已关闭边境，严禁访客入内。你的叛教联盟护照在这儿可不管用，废物。##不过，也许有人能把你偷渡进去？试着在哈洛郡东北海岸找找别的路子。

English: The Clockwork Kingdom has closed its borders, and visitors are strictly forbidden. ##But you've heard of a sky sailor nearby who has been ferrying goods. Perhaps he could also ferry people?
Chinese: 发条王国已关闭边境，严禁访客入内。##不过你听说附近有个天空水手一直在运送货物。或许他也能运人？

English: The Clockwork Kingdom has closed its borders, and visitors are strictly forbidden. ##But Mikhail the sky sailor has agreed to smuggle you inside, for the price of one Apostatic Union Passport.
Chinese: 发条王国已关闭边境，严禁访客入内。##不过天空水手米哈伊尔已同意把你偷渡进去，代价是一本叛教联盟护照。

English: The Clockwork Kingdom has closed its borders, and visitors are strictly forbidden. ##You persuaded Mikhail the sky sailor to smuggle you inside. Speak to him again when you're ready to fly.
Chinese: 发条王国已关闭边境，严禁访客入内。##你说服了天空水手米哈伊尔偷渡你入境。准备好出发时再和他谈一次。

English: You secured regular passage in and out of the Clockwork Kingdom with Mikhail the sky smuggler. ##But you'll need to find your own way to Ferropolis, the capital city.
Chinese: 你通过天空走私贩米哈伊尔获得了定期进出发条王国的通道。##但你还得自己想办法前往国都铁城。

English: You secured regular passage in and out of the Clockwork Kingdom with Mikhail the sky smuggler. ##If you want to use the gatebridge in future, find the Royal Factor at the checkpoint outside Ferropolis and tell her Mikhail sent you.
Chinese: 你通过天空走私贩米哈伊尔获得了定期进出发条王国的通道。##今后若想使用关卡桥，去找铁城外检查站的皇家事务官，就说米哈伊尔让你来的。

English: Mikhail's crooked contact inside the Clockwork Kingdom is willing to grant you a travel permit, but only if you do her a favour first. ##Find the lost royal freight capsule somewhere in the countryside northwest of Ferropolis, and bring whatever's inside back to the Royal Factor at the city checkpoint.
Chinese: 米哈伊尔在发条王国内部的黑心线人愿意给你办通行许可，但你得先帮她个忙。##在铁城西北郊外某处找到失踪的王室货运舱，把里面的东西带回城门检查站交给皇家事务官。

English: Mikhail's crooked contact inside the Clockwork Kingdom is willing to grant you a travel permit, but only if you do her a favour first. ##You found the lost freight capsule and discovered a preserved head inside. Bring it to the Royal Factor at the checkpoint outside Ferropolis to earn her trust.
Chinese: 米哈伊尔在发条王国内部的黑心线人愿意给你办通行许可，但你得先帮她个忙。##你找到了失踪的货运舱，里面竟是一颗腌渍保存的头颅。把它送到铁城外检查站交给皇家事务官，赢取她的信任。

English: You secured an official travel permit for Clockwork Kingdom, thanks to Mikhail the sky smuggler and his crooked contact. ##Use it to pass through the gatebridges along the western edge of the Kingdom.
Chinese: 多亏天空走私贩米哈伊尔和他的黑心线人，你拿到了发条王国的官方通行许可。##凭它即可通过王国西部边境的关卡桥。

English: You have been granted the rare privilege of travelling freely between the Apostatic Union and the Clockwork Kingdom, thanks to Mikhail the sky smuggler and his crooked contact. ##Isn't it amazing what you can achieve with a little quid pro quo?
Chinese: 多亏天空走私贩米哈伊尔和他的黑心线人，你获得了罕见的特权：在叛教联盟与发条王国之间自由往来。##一点投桃报李，竟能办成这么多事，是不是很奇妙？

English: Sky Pirate Caxton Frost
Chinese: 天空海盗卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特

English: You've heard about a former Dark Star mercenary named Caxton Frost, who hailed from the Clockwork Kingdom. Unfortunately, he seems to be dead. ##Perhaps if you keep asking around, you'll discover something more useful.
Chinese: 你听说了一位名叫卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特的前黑星佣兵，出身发条王国。不巧的是，他似乎已经死了。##不过多打听打听，说不定能挖出更有用的消息。

English: Jack Basalt has told you of Caxton Frost - a skilled 'techno-archaeologist' who was once a Dark Star mercenary. ##Basalt believes he may have returned to his homeland in the Clockwork Kingdom. Look for a man who has trouble walking, with a moth tattoo on his left buttock.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特向你提起了卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特——一位技艺精湛的"科技考古学家"，曾是黑星佣兵。##巴索特认为他可能回了发条王国的老家。找一个走路不利索、左屁股上有飞蛾纹身的男人。

English: You're on the trail of Caxton Frost, a former comrade of Vela Callose who hailed from the Clockwork Kingdom. ##Supposedly Frost is dead, but the vision trader in Ferropolis told you of a man called Horace Metcalfe out in the countryside who might know something.
Chinese: 你正在追查卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特——薇拉·卡洛斯的前同伴，出身发条王国。##据说弗罗斯特已死，但铁城的幻象商人向你提起一个住在乡下的名叫霍勒斯·梅特卡夫的人，也许知道些什么。

English: You're on the trail of Caxton Frost, a former comrade of Vela Callose who hailed from the Clockwork Kingdom. ##You met a man named Horace Metcalfe in the mountains northeast of Ferropolis, who might know something.
Chinese: 你正在追查卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特——薇拉·卡洛斯的前同伴，出身发条王国。##你在铁城东北的山里遇到了一个名叫霍勒斯·梅特卡夫的男人，他也许知道些什么。

English: You're on the trail of Caxton Frost, a former comrade of Vela Callose who hailed from the Clockwork Kingdom. ##You met a man named Horace Metcalfe in the mountains northeast of Ferropolis, who was suspiciously knowledgeable about Vela and the Dark Stars. ##Persuade Metcalfe to tell you what he really knows.
Chinese: 你正在追查卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特——薇拉·卡洛斯的前同伴，出身发条王国。##你在铁城东北的山里遇到了一个名叫霍勒斯·梅特卡夫的男人，他对薇拉和黑星的了解多得可疑。##说服梅特卡夫说出他真正知道的事。

English: You believe you've found one of Vela Callose's former comrades living undercover in the Clockwork Kingdom, going by the name 'Horace Metcalfe'. Just one problem: he doesn't remember who he is. ##To persuade him, you'll need to gather more evidence. Search Metcalfe's house for his private stash of bottled visions.
Chinese: 你确信自己找到了薇拉·卡洛斯的一位前同伴——他隐姓埋名住在发条王国，化名"霍勒斯·梅特卡夫"。只有一个问题：他不记得自己是谁。##要说服他，你需要收集更多证据。搜一搜梅特卡夫的房子，找找他私藏的瓶装幻象。

English: You believe you've found one of Vela Callose's former comrades living undercover in the Clockwork Kingdom, going by the name 'Horace Metcalfe'. Just one problem: he doesn't remember who he is. ##You 'borrowed' a bottled vision from Metcalfe's private stash. Now find a safe place to imbibe it.
Chinese: 你确信自己找到了薇拉·卡洛斯的一位前同伴——他隐姓埋名住在发条王国，化名"霍勒斯·梅特卡夫"。只有一个问题：他不记得自己是谁。##你从梅特卡夫的私藏里"借"了一瓶瓶装幻象。现在找个安全的地方把它喝下去。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##Metcalfe's bottled visions point to a ruined city in the Clockwork Kingdom, which seems to hold some key to his past. ##Find a way into the Corrupted Lands, southeast of Ferropolis, to begin your search.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##梅特卡夫的瓶装幻象指向发条王国一座废墟之城，那里似乎藏着他过往的关键。##想办法进入铁城东南的腐化之地，开始搜寻。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##Metcalfe's bottled visions point to a ruined city in the Clockwork Kingdom, which seems to hold some key to his past. ##Search the Corrupted Lands for any sign of this lost city.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##梅特卡夫的瓶装幻象指向发条王国一座废墟之城，那里似乎藏着他过往的关键。##在腐化之地搜寻这座失落之城的踪迹。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##Metcalfe's bottled visions point to the ruined city of Progress, which was quarantined after falling prey to the Corruption. ##Cross the broken island chain in the far south-east of the Clockwork Kingdom to reach the city.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##梅特卡夫的瓶装幻象指向废墟之城进步废都——它沦陷于腐化之后便遭隔离。##穿过发条王国极东南的断裂岛链，抵达那座城市。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##Metcalfe's bottled visions point to the ruined city of Progress, which was quarantined after falling prey to the Corruption. ##Search the city for clues to his past.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##梅特卡夫的瓶装幻象指向废墟之城进步废都——它沦陷于腐化之后便遭隔离。##在城市中搜寻有关他过往的线索。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##Metcalfe's bottled visions led you to an old music box cylinder, hidden in a chest in the ruined city of Progress. ##Return to Metcalfe's house in the mountains northeast of Ferropolis and see what he makes of it.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##梅特卡夫的瓶装幻象引你找到了一枚旧音乐盒圆筒，它藏在进步废都的一口箱子里。##回到铁城东北山中的梅特卡夫家，看看他对此有何反应。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##In the ruined city of Progress, you found a missing cylinder belonging to the music box in Metcalfe's house. See if playing it brings back any memories.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##你在进步废都找到了梅特卡夫家中音乐盒缺失的圆筒。放放看，能否唤回些记忆。

English: Horace Metcalfe has lost all memory of being a Dark Star mercenary, and it's up to you to cure his amnesia. ##The music that you found in the ruined city of Progress seems to have had a strange effect on him. You should check to see if he's okay.
Chinese: 霍勒斯·梅特卡夫全然忘却了自己身为黑星佣兵的过往，治好他的失忆就靠你了。##你在进步废都找到的那段音乐似乎对他产生了奇怪的影响。你应该去看看他是否安好。

English: You recruited Caxton Frost to your cause, and he has joined you in Vela's old fortress, the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 你将卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特招募到你的事业中，他已加入你在薇拉旧堡垒——炫光要塞——的行列。

English: You recruited Caxton Frost to your cause, and he has joined you in Vela's old fortress, the Blinding Light. ##You convinced him to use the treasure Vela seeks for his own ends, and create the 'better world' he's always dreamed of.
Chinese: 你将卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特招募到你的事业中，他已加入你在薇拉旧堡垒——炫光要塞——的行列。##你说服他把薇拉追寻的珍宝用在自己的目标上，去创造他梦寐以求的"更美好的世界"。

English: You recruited Caxton Frost to your cause, and he has joined you in Vela's old fortress, the Blinding Light. ##You convinced him to abandon his utopian dreams, and stop Vela before her quest for paradise unleashes a catastrophe.
Chinese: 你将卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特招募到你的事业中，他已加入你在薇拉旧堡垒——炫光要塞——的行列。##你说服他放弃乌托邦之梦，在薇拉的寻乐园引发灾祸之前阻止她。

English: You recruited Caxton Frost to your cause and restored his memories. Find him at Vela's old fortress, the Blinding Light. ##You convinced him to strive for a better world one step at a time - and to start by preventing Vela from unleashing a catastrophe.
Chinese: 你将卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特招募到你的事业中，并恢复了他的记忆。他在薇拉旧堡垒——炫光要塞——与你会合。##你说服他一步一步地为一个更好的世界努力——就从阻止薇拉引发灾祸开始。

English: Madness of the King
Chinese: 国王的疯狂

English: Upon reaching Ferropolis, the capital city, you were detained by the all-powerful Machinists' Guild and ordered to meet the King in its sanctum atop the Machinarium. Who are you to question a royal decree?
Chinese: 一抵达国都铁城，你就被权势滔天的机械师公会扣留，并被勒令前往机械殿顶层的圣所觐见国王。区区你辈，也配质疑王命？

English: The King has ordered you to perform something called the 'Sacramental Duty', but its instructions made no sense. ##Perhaps someone in Ferropolis can tell you more?
Chinese: 国王命你执行一项名为"圣礼职责"的差事，但那些指示完全莫名其妙。##也许铁城里有人能告诉你更多？

English: The King has ordered you to perform something called the 'Sacramental Duty', but its instructions made no sense. ##Afterwards, someone slipped you an enigmatic note asking you to meet them [[at night]] in the park in [[Upper Ferropolis]], under the [[gazebo]].
Chinese: 国王命你执行一项名为"圣礼职责"的差事，但那些指示完全莫名其妙。##随后，有人偷偷塞给你一张神秘字条，约你[[夜里]]在[[上铁城]]的公园[[凉亭]]下见面。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, trapping its people in perpetual winter. You met a reformist engineer named Aphra who believes she knows why. ##To demonstrate her claims, she asked you to walk through a mirror hidden inside a house in the lower district of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，把它的子民困在永冬之中。你遇到一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师，她自认知道原因。##为证明自己的说法，她请你穿过铁城下城区某座房子里藏着的一面镜子。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, trapping its people in perpetual winter. You met a reformist engineer named Aphra who believes she knows why. ##You followed Aphra's directions to a hidden portal and found yourself in a frozen mirrorworld. How are you going to get out of here?
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，把它的子民困在永冬之中。你遇到一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师，她自认知道原因。##你依照阿芙拉的指引找到一座隐藏传送门，却发现身处一个冰封的镜像世界。你要怎么离开这里？

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing its own citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes she can fix it, but she needs your help. ##If you're willing, meet her back at the [[park gazebo]] in Upper Ferropolis after [[nightfall]].
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信自己能修复这一切，但她需要你的帮助。##若你愿意，[[夜幕降临]]后到上铁城的[[公园凉亭]]与她碰头。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing its own citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help her fix it. ##First, Aphra asked you to search the graveyard northwest of Ferropolis for a hidden message from the King. The graveyard keeper can tell you more.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮她修复这一切。##首先，阿芙拉请你去铁城西北的墓场寻找国王留下的隐秘讯息。墓场看守能告诉你更多。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing its own citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help her fix it. ##Aphra asked you to search the graveyard northwest of Ferropolis for a hidden message from the King, but the gate is locked. You'd best find the graveyard keeper's hut.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮她修复这一切。##阿芙拉请你去铁城西北的墓场寻找国王留下的隐秘讯息，但大门锁着。你最好去找找墓场看守的小屋。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing its own citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help fix it. ##First, Aphra asked you to search the object graveyard northwest of Ferropolis for a hidden message from the King. Start with those mysterious yellow boxes the graveyard keeper mentioned.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮忙修复这一切。##首先，阿芙拉请你去铁城西北的物件墓场寻找国王留下的隐秘讯息。就从墓场看守提到的那些神秘黄匣子查起。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help fix it. ##You transcribed a secret message left by the King in the object graveyard northwest of Ferropolis. ##Return to Aphra in the park in Ferropolis after nightfall.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮忙修复这一切。##你抄录下了国王留在铁城西北物件墓场的密讯。##夜幕降临后回铁城公园找阿芙拉。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing its own citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help fix it. ##To speak with the King, you'll need a mechanical implant installed into your skull. Seek out Morozov the cranial engineer in the mountains north of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮忙修复这一切。##要与国王交谈，你得在颅骨里植入一枚机械植入体。去找铁城北面山中的颅腔工程师莫罗佐夫。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help fix it. ##You persuaded the reclusive Morozov to install a Cranial Moderator into your skull so you can speak to the King. ##Talk to Morozov again in her alpine tower when you're ready to install it.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮忙修复这一切。##你说服了隐居的莫罗佐夫在你的颅骨中安装颅腔调节器，好让你与国王交谈。##准备好安装时，去她那座高山之塔再和她谈谈。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help fix it. ##You persuaded the reclusive Morozov to install a Cranial Moderator into your skull so you can speak to the King. ##Return to Aphra in the park in Ferropolis after nightfall for your next task.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮忙修复这一切。##你说服了隐居的莫罗佐夫在你的颅骨中安装颅腔调节器，好让你与国王交谈。##夜幕降临后回铁城公园找阿芙拉，领取下一个任务。

English: The Clockwork King has gone mad, erasing citizens from reality at an ever-increasing rate. A reformist engineer named Aphra believes you can help fix it. ##To secure an audience with the King, you must travel into the Corrupted Lands and reactivate a disused communication beacon. ##The beacon is on a hilltop far east of Ferropolis, across a huge artificial ditch.
Chinese: 发条王已经疯了，正以越来越快的速度把国民从现实中抹除。一位名叫阿芙拉的改革派工程师相信你能帮忙修复这一切。##要获得觐见国王的机会，你必须前往腐化之地，重新启动一座废弃的通讯信标。##信标位于铁城以东很远的一座山顶，要跨过一条巨大的人工沟渠。

English: Aphra's plan to fix the Clockwork King is nearing fruition. You travelled into the Corrupted Lands and activated a disused communication beacon. ##But afterwards you received a transmission from Mikhail the smuggler, warning you not to trust Aphra and asking you to seek out his mysterious 'friends'. ##Find a market trader named Reza in Ferropolis and mention the 'seventh letter', before or after returning to Aphra.
Chinese: 阿芙拉修复发条王的计划临近尾声。你前往腐化之地，启动了一座废弃的通讯信标。##但随后你收到走私贩米哈伊尔的讯号，警告你别信阿芙拉，并让你去找他那些神秘的"朋友"。##在铁城找到一个名叫雷扎的市场摊贩，提一句"第七封信"——回阿芙拉那里之前或之后都行。

English: Aphra's plan to fix the Clockwork King is nearing fruition. You travelled into the Corrupted Lands and activated a disused communication beacon. ##But afterwards you received a transmission from a mysterious voice, warning you not to trust Aphra. ##The voice asked you to find a market trader named Reza in Ferropolis and mention the 'seventh letter', before or after returning to Aphra.
Chinese: 阿芙拉修复发条王的计划临近尾声。你前往腐化之地，启动了一座废弃的通讯信标。##但随后你收到一个神秘声音的讯号，警告你别信阿芙拉。##那声音让你在铁城找到一个名叫雷扎的市场摊贩，提一句"第七封信"——回阿芙拉那里之前或之后都行。

English: Aphra's plan to fix the Clockwork King is nearing fruition. But a shadowy rebel group has reached out to you with a different offer... ##You met with Reza, an undercover Saboteur, who gave you a punchcard that would kill the King. ##Return to Aphra for your final task. She waits for you at the park gazebo at night.
Chinese: 阿芙拉修复发条王的计划临近尾声。但一个隐秘的反叛团体向你抛出了另一种提议……##你见了雷扎——一名卧底破坏者，她给了你一张能杀死国王的打孔卡。##回去找阿芙拉领取最后的任务。夜里她在公园凉亭等你。

English: You've secured a second audience with the Clockwork King, and a chance to end its madness. ##Aphra gave you a punchcard that will reform the King's powers, which must be inserted inside its sanctum atop the Machinarium. ##Yet a mystery third party warned you not to trust Aphra, asking you to find a trader named Reza in Ferropolis and mention the 'seventh letter'. ##Of course, Speaker Sunil would surely reward you for reporting Aphra's plot...
Chinese: 你获得了第二次觐见发条王的机会，也是终结其疯狂的机会。##阿芙拉给了你一张能改革国王权柄的打孔卡，必须插入机械殿顶层的圣所。##然而一个神秘的第三方警告你别信阿芙拉，让你在铁城找到一个名叫雷扎的摊贩，提一句"第七封信"。##当然，把阿芙拉的密谋报告给国王代言人苏尼尔，他肯定会有所酬谢……

English: You've secured a second audience with the Clockwork King, and a chance to end its madness. ##Aphra gave you a punchcard that will reform the King's powers, which must be inserted inside its sanctum atop the Machinarium.  ##Reza the Saboteur gave you another punchcard that will destroy the King, ending its tyranny but plunging the kingdom into chaos. ##Of course, Speaker Sunil would surely reward you for reporting Aphra's plot...
Chinese: 你获得了第二次觐见发条王的机会，也是终结其疯狂的机会。##阿芙拉给了你一张能改革国王权柄的打孔卡，必须插入机械殿顶层的圣所。##破坏者雷扎给了你另一张能毁灭国王的打孔卡——终结其暴政，却会让王国陷入混乱。##当然，把阿芙拉的密谋报告给国王代言人苏尼尔，他肯定会有所酬谢……

English: You enacted Aphra's spell upon the Clockwork King, reforming its powers so that it can only alter people according to their own wishes. ##Aphra will be overjoyed. She's waiting in the park in Ferropolis after nightfall, with your reward.
Chinese: 你将阿芙拉的咒文施加于发条王，改革了它的权柄：从此它只能依照人们自己的意愿改造他们。##阿芙拉会欣喜若狂。夜幕降临后她在铁城公园等你，还带着给你的奖励。

English: You enacted the Saboteur's spell upon the Clockwork King, ending its tyranny and setting the kingdom on a path to chaos. ##Aphra will want to know what happened. She's waiting for you in the park in Ferropolis after nightfall.
Chinese: 你将破坏者的咒文施加于发条王，终结了它的暴政，也让王国走上了通往混乱的道路。##阿芙拉会想知道发生了什么。夜幕降临后她在铁城公园等你。

English: You betrayed Aphra's reformist plot to the Machinists' Guild, and were richly rewarded for your service. ##The madness of the Clockwork King will continue, as will the perpetual winter and mass vanishings that plague this land. But that's not your problem, is it?
Chinese: 你把阿芙拉的改革密谋出卖给了机械师公会，并因"忠诚服务"获得丰厚报酬。##发条王的疯狂仍将继续，永冬与大规模失踪仍将肆虐这片土地。不过那不是你的问题，对吧？

English: You betrayed Aphra's reformist plot to the Machinists' Guild, only to forfeit the rich reward you were offered. ##The madness of the Clockwork King will continue, as will the perpetual winter and mass vanishings that plague this land. But that's not your problem, is it?
Chinese: 你把阿芙拉的改革密谋出卖给了机械师公会，却落得个鸡飞蛋打，承诺的丰厚报酬也没了影。##发条王的疯狂仍将继续，永冬与大规模失踪仍将肆虐这片土地。不过那不是你的问题，对吧？

English: You enacted Aphra's spell upon the Clockwork King, reforming its powers so that it can only alter people according to their own wishes. ##The King's reign will continue, but it will begin to repair its madness. It will be long and uncertain process, but thanks to you there is hope for the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 你将阿芙拉的咒文施加于发条王，改革了它的权柄：从此它只能依照人们自己的意愿改造他们。##国王的统治将继续，但它会开始修补自己的疯狂。这将是一个漫长而充满变数的过程，但多亏了你，发条王国还有希望。

English: You enacted the Saboteur's spell upon the Clockwork King, locking it into an irreversible shutdown sequence. ##The King's madness will end, along with its reign, and the Kingdom will be plunged into chaos. Maybe something better will grow from the rubble.##You have fooled Aphra into believing that this is all the result of her spell.
Chinese: 你将破坏者的咒文施加于发条王，把它锁进了一个不可逆的关机程序。##国王的疯狂将随其统治一同终结，王国将陷入混乱。或许废墟之上能长出更好的东西。##你骗过了阿芙拉，让她相信这一切都是她的咒文所致。

English: You enacted the Saboteur's spell upon the Clockwork King, locking it into an irreversible shutdown sequence. ##The King's madness will end, along with its reign, and the Kingdom will be plunged into chaos. Maybe something better will grow from the rubble.
Chinese: 你将破坏者的咒文施加于发条王，把它锁进了一个不可逆的关机程序。##国王的疯狂将随其统治一同终结，王国将陷入混乱。或许废墟之上能长出更好的东西。

English: Missing Persons
Chinese: 失踪人口

English: Sunil, the chief adviser to the Clockwork King, has asked you to investigate a message left on the missing persons noticeboard in Ferropolis by a grieving father called 'Olaf' or 'Omar'. ##You can find the noticeboard down underneath the bridge that leads to the Machinarium.
Chinese: 发条王的首席顾问苏尼尔请你调查铁城失踪人口布告栏上的一条留言，留言者是一位悲痛的父亲，署名"奥拉夫"或"奥马尔"。##布告栏就在通往机械殿的大桥下面。
