English: Someone named 'Oleg Igorovich' left a haunting message on the missing persons noticeboard in Ferropolis, asking for his child to come home. Perhaps you can help? ##The notice gave directions to a house on the islet northeast of the Machinarium, accessed via the city's rear gate.
Chinese: 一个名叫"奥列格·伊戈罗维奇"的人在铁城的失踪人口布告栏上留了一条令人心碎的讯息，盼他的孩子回家。也许你能帮上忙？##布告上指了路：机械殿东北的小岛上有一栋房子，从城的后门过去。

English: You met an off-duty border guard named Oleg in Ferropolis who was ranting drunkenly about his missing child. ##Before you can get any more detail from him, you'll need to sober him up.
Chinese: 你在铁城遇到了一个休班的边防兵，名叫奥列格，他正醉醺醺地念叨着自己失踪的孩子。##想从他嘴里问出更多，你得先把他弄醒酒。

English: Oleg's missing child has somehow been erased from his memory, and he cannot grieve until he knows their name. ##Though almost too proud to accept your help, Oleg gave you his child's locket and told you to seek the 'Library of Untruths' somewhere west of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 奥列格失踪的孩子不知为何从他的记忆中被抹去了，不知道孩子的名字，他便无法哀悼。##奥列格虽然傲得几乎不肯接受你的帮助，还是把孩子的吊坠交给了你，让你去铁城西面某处寻找"虚言图书馆"。

English: Oleg's missing child has been erased from his memory, and he cannot grieve until he knows their name. ##You found the Library of Untruths, a secret archive of things vanished from reality by the Clockwork King, but the librarian is unable to discuss anything sensitive. Perhaps there's some way to bypass her taboo?
Chinese: 奥列格失踪的孩子已从他的记忆中被抹去，不知道孩子的名字，他便无法哀悼。##你找到了虚言图书馆——发条王从现实中抹除之物的秘密档案库——但图书管理员无法谈论任何敏感内容。也许有什么办法能绕过她的禁忌？

English: Oleg's missing child has been erased from his memory, and he cannot grieve until he knows their name. ##You found the Library of Untruths, a secret archive of things vanished from reality by the Clockwork King, and persuaded the librarian to give you access to the reading room upstairs.
Chinese: 奥列格失踪的孩子已从他的记忆中被抹去，不知道孩子的名字，他便无法哀悼。##你找到了虚言图书馆——发条王从现实中抹除之物的秘密档案库——并说服管理员让你进入楼上的阅览室。

English: You're searching for Oleg's missing child, who has somehow been erased from his memory. ##You found the child's official file in the Library of Untruths, learning that they were part of a secret experiment called Project Horoscope. ##The child's last known location was a place called Istrik Oblast. You'd better ask the librarian what she makes of it.
Chinese: 你正在寻找奥列格失踪的孩子，孩子不知为何已从他的记忆中被抹去。##你在虚言图书馆找到了孩子的官方档案，得知他曾参与一项名为星象计划的秘密实验。##孩子最后为人所知的所在地名叫伊斯特里克州。你最好问问图书管理员对此有何看法。

English: You're searching for Oleg's missing child, who has somehow been erased from his memory. ##You found the child's official file in the Library of Untruths, learning that they were part of a secret experiment called Project Horoscope. ##The child was last seen in the Corrupted Lands, far southeast of Ferropolis. Find the royal cleanup camp and see if anyone there can help.
Chinese: 你正在寻找奥列格失踪的孩子，孩子不知为何已从他的记忆中被抹去。##你在虚言图书馆找到了孩子的官方档案，得知他曾参与一项名为星象计划的秘密实验。##孩子最后现身于铁城极东南的腐化之地。去找皇家清理营地，看看有没有人能帮忙。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands, where cleanup workers of the Clockwork King battle a magical curse. ##If you want to examine the Corrupted Ones in the cage, you'll need permission from Cleanup Leader Huang in the cleanup camp's main building.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地，奥列格失踪的孩子最后在此现身。发条王的清理工人们正在这里对抗一道魔法诅咒。##若想查看笼中的腐化者，你需要获得清理队长黄的许可，他就在营地主楼里。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands, where cleanup workers of the Clockwork King battle a magical curse. ##Cleanup Leader Huang gave you permission to inspect the captured Corrupted Ones at his cleanup camp. ##Speak to Cleanup Worker Cohen to open the cage.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地，奥列格失踪的孩子最后在此现身。发条王的清理工人们正在这里对抗一道魔法诅咒。##清理队长黄已允许你在他的清理营地查看被捕获的腐化者。##找清理工人科恩打开笼子。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands, where cleanup workers of the Clockwork King battle a magical curse. ##A captured Corrupted One at the cleanup camp seemed to recognise Oleg's locket, but you couldn't understand its words. ##Perhaps Cleanup Worker Cohen can tell you more.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地，奥列格失踪的孩子最后在此现身。发条王的清理工人们正在这里对抗一道魔法诅咒。##营地里一只被捕获的腐化者似乎认出了奥列格的吊坠，但你听不懂它的话。##也许清理工人科恩能告诉你更多。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands, where cleanup workers of the Clockwork King battle a magical curse. ##A captured Corrupted One seemed to recognise Oleg's locket, but you need a clockwork skull implant to understand its words. ##Seek out Morozov the cranial engineer in a tower in the mountains north of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地，奥列格失踪的孩子最后在此现身。发条王的清理工人们正在这里对抗一道魔法诅咒。##一只被捕获的腐化者似乎认出了奥列格的吊坠，但你需要一枚发条颅骨植入体才能听懂它的话。##去找铁城北面山中高塔里的颅腔工程师莫罗佐夫。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands. A captured Corrupted One seemed to recognise Oleg's locket, but you need a clockwork skull implant to understand its words. ##Morozov the cranial engineer is willing to help if you retrieve her lost parcel. Search the road leading to her tower in the mountains north of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地。一只被捕获的腐化者似乎认出了奥列格的吊坠，但你需要一枚发条颅骨植入体才能听懂它的话。##颅腔工程师莫罗佐夫愿意帮忙，但条件是你找回她丢失的包裹。在铁城北面山中通往她高塔的路上搜一搜。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands. A captured Corrupted One seemed to recognise Oleg's locket, but you need a clockwork skull implant to understand its words. ##You found a lost parcel belonging to Morozov the cranial engineer. Bring it back to her tower in the mountains north of Ferropolis, then secure her help.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地。一只被捕获的腐化者似乎认出了奥列格的吊坠，但你需要一枚发条颅骨植入体才能听懂它的话。##你找到了颅腔工程师莫罗佐夫丢失的包裹。把它送回铁城北面山中的她的高塔，然后争取她的帮助。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands, where a captured Corrupted One seemed to recognise Oleg's locket. ##You persuaded a reclusive engineer named Morozov to give you a mechanical skull implant so you can understand the Corrupted. ##Talk to Morozov again in her alpine tower when you're ready to install it.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地，一只被捕获的腐化者似乎认出了奥列格的吊坠。##你说服了隐居的工程师莫罗佐夫给你一枚机械颅骨植入体，好让你听懂腐化者的话。##准备好安装时，去她那座高山之塔再和她谈谈。

English: You traced Oleg's missing child to the Corrupted Lands, where a captured Corrupted One seemed to recognise Oleg's locket. ##You persuaded a reclusive engineer named Morozov to give you a mechanical skull implant so you can understand its words. ##Return to the cleanup camp and speak to the Corrupted One again.
Chinese: 你循着线索追到腐化之地，一只被捕获的腐化者似乎认出了奥列格的吊坠。##你说服了隐居的工程师莫罗佐夫给你一枚机械颅骨植入体，好让你听懂它的话。##回清理营地，再和那只腐化者谈一次。

English: You learned the fate of Oleg's missing daughter, Aphra, who was consumed by Corruption after taking part in a secret experiment called Project Horoscope. ##You could return to Oleg's house in Ferropolis and tell him what you found. ##But perhaps you should first confront Speaker Sunil at the Machinarium, and get the whole truth about Project Horoscope.
Chinese: 你得知了奥列格失踪女儿阿芙拉的下落——她参与了名为星象计划的秘密实验，随后被腐化吞噬。##你可以回铁城奥列格的家，告诉他你的发现。##不过，或许你该先去机械殿当面对质国王代言人苏尼尔，弄清星象计划的全部真相。

English: You learned the fate of Oleg's missing daughter, Aphra, who was consumed by Corruption after taking part in a secret experiment called Project Horoscope. ##When confronted, Speaker Sunil admitted that Horoscope was an early test of the Clockwork King's power to magically alter people, and perhaps at the root of the Corruption. ##All that's left is to return to Oleg in his house on the northeast islet of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 你得知了奥列格失踪女儿阿芙拉的下落——她参与了名为星象计划的秘密实验，随后被腐化吞噬。##当面对质时，苏尼尔承认星象计划是发条王魔法改造之力的一次早期试验，或许正是腐化的根源。##剩下的只有回铁城东北小岛的家中去找奥列格了。

English: You learned the fate of Oleg's missing daughter, Aphra, who was consumed by Corruption after serving as a test subject for the Clockwork King's reality-altering powers. ##After listening to your tale, Oleg made one last request: light a candle for her at the missing persons noticeboard in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 你得知了奥列格失踪女儿阿芙拉的下落——她在发条王改写现实之力的试验中充当受试者，最终被腐化吞噬。##听完你的讲述，奥列格提出了最后一个请求：在铁城的失踪人口布告栏为她点一支蜡烛。

English: You learned the fate of Oleg's missing daughter, Aphra, who was consumed by Corruption after serving as a test subject for the Clockwork King's reality-altering powers. ##As a reward, Oleg gave you the key to a lost freight capsule on an outlying island, which can only be reached by air. ##You returned Oleg's locket to him, then lit a candle for Aphra at the missing persons noticeboard in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 你得知了奥列格失踪女儿阿芙拉的下落——她在发条王改写现实之力的试验中充当受试者，最终被腐化吞噬。##作为酬谢，奥列格把边远岛屿上一只失踪货运舱的钥匙给了你，那地方只有飞空才能抵达。##你把吊坠还给了奥列格，然后在铁城的失踪人口布告栏为阿芙拉点了一支蜡烛。

English: You learned the fate of Oleg's missing daughter, Aphra, who was consumed by Corruption after serving as a test subject for the Clockwork King's reality-altering powers. ##As a reward, Oleg gave you the key to a lost freight capsule on an outlying island, which can only be reached by air. ##You left Oleg's locket with whatever remains of his daughter, then lit a candle for her at the missing persons noticeboard in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 你得知了奥列格失踪女儿阿芙拉的下落——她在发条王改写现实之力的试验中充当受试者，最终被腐化吞噬。##作为酬谢，奥列格把边远岛屿上一只失踪货运舱的钥匙给了你，那地方只有飞空才能抵达。##你把奥列格的吊坠留在他女儿残存的一切身边，然后在铁城的失踪人口布告栏为她点了一支蜡烛。

English: The Vision Trade
Chinese: 幻象生意

English: A bottled vision trader in the Clockwork Kingdom asked you to go and check on Nadja, one of his regular customers. ##Nadja lives at the top of a tall tenement building in the upper levels of Ferropolis.
Chinese: 发条王国的一个瓶装幻象商人请你去看看他的老主顾娜佳。##娜佳住在铁城上城区一栋高层公寓的顶楼。

English: Yasmeen's daughter Nadja has fallen into an endless sleep due to her bottled vision addiction, leaving her family on the brink of ruin. ##Confront Vidal the vision trader at his shop in Ferropolis, and find out whether Nadja can be cured.
Chinese: 亚斯敏的女儿娜佳因沉迷瓶装幻象陷入无尽沉睡，整个家庭濒临破产。##去铁城的店里找幻象商人维达尔当面对质，看看娜佳还有没有救。

English: Yasmeen's daughter Nadja has fallen into an endless sleep due to her bottled vision addiction, leaving her family on the brink of ruin. ##Vidal the vision trader advised you to seek help from Doctor Pripp at the Royal Vision Works in the far northeast of the Clockwork Kingdom, beyond the mountains.
Chinese: 亚斯敏的女儿娜佳因沉迷瓶装幻象陷入无尽沉睡，整个家庭濒临破产。##幻象商人维达尔建议你去找发条王国极东北、群山之外的皇家幻象工坊求助普里普医生。

English: Yasmeen's daughter Nadja has fallen into an endless sleep due to her bottled vision addiction, leaving her family on the brink of ruin. ##You arrived at the Royal Vision Works in search of a cure, but the clerk won't let you see Doctor Pripp. Persuade her, or find another way in.
Chinese: 亚斯敏的女儿娜佳因沉迷瓶装幻象陷入无尽沉睡，整个家庭濒临破产。##你抵达皇家幻象工坊寻求疗法，但职员不肯让你见普里普医生。说服她，或者另找门路。

English: Yasmeen's daughter Nadja has fallen into an endless sleep due to bottled vision addiction, leaving her family on the brink of ruin. ##You managed to find a way inside the Royal Vision Works, where you've been told you might find a cure for Nadja. Now look for Doctor Pripp.
Chinese: 亚斯敏的女儿娜佳因沉迷瓶装幻象陷入无尽沉睡，整个家庭濒临破产。##你成功进入了皇家幻象工坊——据说这里或许有治好娜佳的办法。现在去找普里普医生。

English: Yasmeen's daughter Nadja has fallen into an endless sleep due to bottled vision addiction, and the sickness is incurable. ##Doctor Pripp offered Nadja a place at the Royal Vision Works, where her dreams will be harvested industrially. ##Alternatively, Yasmeen could buy a 'dream crown' and start bottling Nadja's visions in her own home. ##Return to Yasmeen in Ferropolis and see what she thinks.
Chinese: 亚斯敏的女儿娜佳因沉迷瓶装幻象陷入无尽沉睡，且病不可治。##普里普医生提出让娜佳住进皇家幻象工坊，她的梦境将在那里被工业化收割。##或者，亚斯敏可以买一顶"梦境之冠"，在家里自行装瓶出售娜佳的幻象。##回铁城问问亚斯敏的想法。

English: Yasmeen's daughter Nadja has fallen into an endless sleep due to bottled vision addiction, and the sickness is incurable. ##Doctor Pripp promised you a finder's fee if you persuade her to check Nadja into the Royal Vision Works. ##Alternatively, you could give Yasmeen money to buy a 'dream crown', so that she could bottle Nadja's visions in her own home. ##Let Yasmeen know your decision.
Chinese: 亚斯敏的女儿娜佳因沉迷瓶装幻象陷入无尽沉睡，且病不可治。##普里普医生许诺，若你说服她收治娜佳入住皇家幻象工坊，便给你一笔介绍费。##或者，你可以给亚斯敏一笔钱买"梦境之冠"，让她在家里自行装瓶出售娜佳的幻象。##把你的决定告诉亚斯敏。

English: Yasmeen decided to send her daughter Nadja to the Royal Vision Works, where her dreams will be harvested until a cure to her sickness is found. ##As thanks for your help, Yasmeen gave you the deed to her family home outside Ferropolis. ##Pick up your finder's fee from Vidal the vision trader to settle this affair.
Chinese: 亚斯敏决定把女儿娜佳送往皇家幻象工坊，在那里收割她的梦境，直到找到治愈她的方法。##为答谢你的帮助，亚斯敏把铁城外她家老宅的地契给了你。##去幻象商人维达尔那里领你的介绍费，了结这桩事。

English: Yasmeen decided to send her daughter Nadja to the Royal Vision Works, allowing her to live comfortably on the proceeds of Nadja's dreams until her sickness can be cured. ##As thanks for your help, Yasmeen gave you the deed to her family home outside Ferropolis, giving you a permanent base inside the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 亚斯敏决定把女儿娜佳送往皇家幻象工坊，靠娜佳梦境的收益过上衣食无忧的日子，直到病愈之日。##为答谢你的帮助，亚斯敏把铁城外她家老宅的地契给了你——从此你在发条王国有了永久的落脚点。

English: You gave Yasmeen money to set herself up as an independent bottled vision producer, selling Nadja's visions from home until her sickness can be cured. ##As thanks for your help, Yasmeen gave you the deed to her family home outside Ferropolis, giving you a permanent base inside the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 你给了亚斯敏一笔钱，让她自立门户成为独立的瓶装幻象生产者，在家出售娜佳的幻象，直到病愈之日。##为答谢你的帮助，亚斯敏把铁城外她家老宅的地契给了你——从此你在发条王国有了永久的落脚点。

English: Secrets and Spores
Chinese: 秘密与孢子

English: In Pwyll Village you met a young man called Lludd, who spoke of Pwyll's failing crops - and how the villagers are being driven to illegal god-worship. ##Weighmaster Culwych is trying to stop this, and you should speak to him for more information.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到一个名叫卢德的年轻人，他说起普威尔歉收的庄稼——以及村民们如何被迫走向非法的神明崇拜。##秤量官卡尔威奇正试图阻止这一切，去找他了解更多情况。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who refuses to speak with you until you are weighed on his enormous scales. ##You should probably humour him.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他拒绝与你交谈，除非你先上他那巨大的秤称一称重量。##你还是陪他玩玩吧。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who refused to speak with you until you were weighed on his enormous scales. ##You've weighed yourself, and so should probably report back to him.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他拒绝与你交谈，除非你先上他那巨大的秤称一称重量。##你已称过体重，现在该回去向他报到了。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who is worried that failing crops are leading some to resort to illegal practices. ##You should investigate the village for signs of god-worship and cultism.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他担心歉收的庄稼会让一些人铤而走险。##你应该在村子里调查神明崇拜和邪教活动的迹象。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who wants you to investigate the village for signs of god-worship and cultism. ##In Mayor Olwen's basement you found suspicious Wikkan artefacts.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他要你调查村中神明崇拜和邪教活动的迹象。##在奥尔温镇长的地下室里，你发现了可疑的维坎器物。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who wants you to investigate the village for signs of god-worship and cultism. ##You've been advised that someone at the Scryshroom Company might know something useful.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他要你调查村中神明崇拜和邪教活动的迹象。##有人指点你，窥菇公司里也许有人知道些有用的消息。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who wants you to investigate the village for signs of god-worship and cultism. ##You've been advised that someone could be skulking around at night - so you could try resting in the Scryshroom Company's bed until nightfall.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他要你调查村中神明崇拜和邪教活动的迹象。##有人指点你，夜里可能有人在暗中鬼祟活动——你可以试试在窥菇公司的床上休息到天黑。

English: In Pwyll Village you met weighmaster Culwych, who wants you to investigate the village for signs of god-worship and cultism. ##You met a suspicious figure skulking around after nightfall. You should follow them and see what they're up to.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你遇到了秤量官卡尔威奇，他要你调查村中神明崇拜和邪教活动的迹象。##天黑后你遇到一个鬼鬼祟祟的可疑身影。你应该跟上看看他在搞什么名堂。

English: In Pwyll Village you found evidence of god-worship deep in the caves under the town. Weighmaster Culwych will surely want to hear of this.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你在镇子地下的洞穴深处发现了神明崇拜的证据。秤量官卡尔威奇一定想听听这件事。

English: In Pwyll Village you found evidence of god-worship, and Weighmaster Culwych thinks an occult sacrifice might be taking place in the Sacred Shroom to the north-west. He has asked you to enter the giant mushroom and investigate.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，你发现了神明崇拜的证据，秤量官卡尔威奇认为西北方的神圣蘑菇里可能正在举行神秘献祭。他要你进入那株巨型蘑菇调查。

English: In the Sacred Shroom in Pwyll, you've discovered a partially-digested young man surrounded by occult instruments. You should try and speak with him.
Chinese: 在普威尔的神圣蘑菇里，你发现一个被消化了一半的年轻人，身边散落着神秘法器。你应该试着和他说说话。

English: In the Sacred Shroom in Pwyll, you found Lludd trying to sacrifice himself for the good of the village. ##You allowed him to die so the village might prosper. You should inform Culwych what has happened.
Chinese: 在普威尔的神圣蘑菇里，你发现卢德正试图为村子的福祉献祭自己。##你任由他死去，好让村子兴旺。你应该把发生的事告诉卡尔威奇。

English: In Pwyll's Sacred Shroom, Lludd sacrificed himself so that the ancient god Anguin might grant a fertile harvest to the region once more.
Chinese: 在普威尔的神圣蘑菇里，卢德献祭了自己，好让古神安圭因再度赐予这片土地丰收。

English: In the Sacred Shroom in Pwyll, you found Lludd trying to sacrifice himself for the good of the village. ##You stopped him from throwing away his life. You should inform Culwych what has happened.
Chinese: 在普威尔的神圣蘑菇里，你发现卢德正试图为村子的福祉献祭自己。##你阻止了他白白送命。你应该把发生的事告诉卡尔威奇。

English: In Pwyll's Sacred Shroom, you stopped Lludd from sacrificing himself for the good of the village.
Chinese: 在普威尔的神圣蘑菇里，你阻止了卢德为村子的福祉献祭自己。

English: The Rotten Onions
Chinese: 烂洋葱佣兵团

English: In Pwyll Village a young man called Lludd told you that his mother - the mayor - is very worried about a certain monster. You should pay her a visit.
Chinese: 在普威尔村，一个名叫卢德的年轻人告诉你，他的母亲——镇长——正为某只怪物忧心忡忡。你应该去拜访她。

English: In Pwyll you met a guard of the Rotten Onion mercenary company, who mentioned that they're threatening the mayor of Pwyll Village with a giant monster. ##Perhaps you should talk to the mayor about this.
Chinese: 在普威尔，你遇到一名烂洋葱佣兵团的守卫，他提到他们正用一只巨型怪物威胁普威尔村的镇长。##也许你该去找镇长谈谈这件事。

English: Olwen, The mayor of Pwyll Village, has told you that a mercenary company is threatening the town with a giant monster. ##She has asked you to investigate their camp, to the south-east, and find a way to stop them.
Chinese: 普威尔村镇长奥尔温告诉你，一家佣兵团正用巨型怪物威胁镇子。##她请你调查他们东南方的营地，想办法阻止他们。

English: Olwen, The mayor of Pwyll Village, has told you that a mercenary company is threatening the town with a giant monster. ##The ex-mercenary Nudd has told you to be cautious - as he doesn't think a monster of that type exists. Could this be a bluff?
Chinese: 普威尔村镇长奥尔温告诉你，一家佣兵团正用巨型怪物威胁镇子。##前佣兵纳德叮嘱你要小心——他不认为那种类型的怪物存在。这会不会是虚张声势？

English: You discovered that the Rotten Onion mercenaries, who have been threatening Pwyll Village with a monster, have been bluffing all along - the monster is actually an illusion. ##You should report back to mayor OIwen with your findings.
Chinese: 你发现一直在用怪物威胁普威尔村的烂洋葱佣兵从头到尾都在虚张声势——那怪物其实是个幻象。##你应该带着发现回去向镇长奥尔温汇报。

English: You discovered that the Rotten Onion mercenaries were threatening Pwyll with an illusory monster, and posed no real threat. ##You managed to solve the situation without too much bloodshed, and Pwyll's mayor was very grateful.
Chinese: 你发现烂洋葱佣兵用来威胁普威尔的怪物只是幻象，并无实际威胁。##你没流多少血就化解了这场风波，普威尔镇长感激不尽。

English: You killed the leader of the Rotten Onion mercenaries, who have been threatening Pwyll village. ##The mayor of the village will surely want to hear of this.
Chinese: 你杀死了威胁普威尔村的烂洋葱佣兵团头目。##镇长一定想听听这件事。

English: You took care of the Rotten Onion mercenaries who had been threatening Pwyll Village, even if you did have to spill some blood to make the problem go away.
Chinese: 你摆平了威胁普威尔村的烂洋葱佣兵，虽然确实流了点血才让问题消失。

English: A Debt Unpaid
Chinese: 未偿的债

English: You met a Rotten Onion mercenary in the south-east of Pwyll, who claims they have not been paid by the village's mayor. ##He says that if you steal the mayor's ledger, you'll be allowed into the Rotten Onion camp.
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南遇到一名烂洋葱佣兵，他声称镇长还没付他们钱。##他说，如果你偷来镇长的账本，他就放你进烂洋葱营地。

English: You met a Rotten Onion mercenary in the south-east of Pwyll, who claims they have not been paid by the village's mayor. He says that if you steal the mayor's ledger, you'll be allowed into the Rotten Onion camp. ##He also added that your best chance of finding the ledger would be to sneak in at night.
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南遇到一名烂洋葱佣兵，他声称镇长还没付他们钱。他说，如果你偷来镇长的账本，他就放你进烂洋葱营地。##他还补充说，想找到账本，最好趁夜潜入。

English: You met a Rotten Onion mercenary in the south-east of Pwyll, who claims they have not been paid by the village's mayor. ##You stole the mayor's ledger, as requested by the mercenary - and should return it to him to gain access to their camp.
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南遇到一名烂洋葱佣兵，他声称镇长还没付他们钱。##你照佣兵的要求偷来了镇长的账本——把它还给佣兵，就能进入他们的营地。

English: You gained access to the Rotten Onion mercenary camp in the south-east of Pwyll, after stealing the mayor's ledger and giving it to them.
Chinese: 你偷来镇长的账本交给了佣兵，得以进入普威尔东南的烂洋葱佣兵营地。

English: You gained access to the Rotten Onion mercenary camp in the south-east of Pwyll, by flattering the guard.
Chinese: 你靠奉承守卫，得以进入普威尔东南的烂洋葱佣兵营地。

English: You gained access to the Rotten Onion mercenary camp in the south-east of Pwyll, by killing the guard at the gates.
Chinese: 你杀掉门口的守卫，得以进入普威尔东南的烂洋葱佣兵营地。

English: Militant Agriculture
Chinese: 武装农业

English: You destroyed a rogue machine in the south-east of Pwyll. Perhaps the nearby residents will be grateful?
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南摧毁了一台失控机器。附近的居民说不定会感激你？

English: You found a strange device in the south-east of Pwyll, which seemed to control a rogue machine. ##You managed to shut down the device - perhaps the nearby residents will be grateful?
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南发现一个奇怪的装置，似乎控制着一台失控机器。##你成功关闭了装置——附近的居民说不定会感激你？

English: You found a strange device in the south-east of Pwyll, which seemed to control a rogue machine. ##You managed to change the device's protocols to make it friendly - perhaps the nearby residents will be grateful?
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南发现一个奇怪的装置，似乎控制着一台失控机器。##你成功修改了装置的协议，让它变得友善——附近的居民说不定会感激你？

English: You met a farmer in the south-east of Pwyll whose crops have been raided by a rogue machine. ##He has asked you to disable it, either with violence or through less direct means.
Chinese: 你在普威尔东南遇到一位农民，他的庄稼被一台失控机器糟蹋了。##他请你废掉那台机器——动武或者用些间接手段都行。

English: You destroyed the mech that has been raiding farmsteads in Pwyll. You should return to the farmer at the south-east of the island to claim your reward.
Chinese: 你摧毁了在普威尔劫掠农场的机甲。回岛屿东南找那位农民领赏吧。

English: You shut down the mech that has been raiding farmsteads in Pwyll. You should return to the farmer at the south-east of the island to claim your reward.
Chinese: 你关闭了在普威尔劫掠农场的机甲。回岛屿东南找那位农民领赏吧。

English: You pacified the mech that has been raiding farmsteads in Pwyll. You should return to the farmer at the south-east of the island to claim your reward.
Chinese: 你安抚了在普威尔劫掠农场的机甲。回岛屿东南找那位农民领赏吧。

English: You shut down the mech that had been raiding farmsteads in Pwyll.
Chinese: 你关闭了曾在普威尔劫掠农场的机甲。

English: You changed the protocols of the mech that had been raiding farmsteads in Pwyll, so that it would help the farmers in the region - rather than hinder them.
Chinese: 你修改了曾在普威尔劫掠农场的机甲的协议，让它开始帮助这一带的农民——而不是妨碍他们。

English: The Rasmussen Sphere
Chinese: 拉斯穆森球体

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter with a device that can pierce its powerful force-fields. ##The High Confessor has heard rumour that one such device was lost in an Emberian wreck on a [[distant island]]; but you'll need an [[airship]] to search for it.
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要为座舰升级一件能穿透其强力力场的装置。##至高忏悔者听到传闻，说这样一件装置失落在[[遥远岛屿]]上的一艘余烬沉船里；但你得有一艘[[飞艇]]才能去搜寻。

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter with a device that can pierce its powerful force-fields. ##You've found a [[desert island]] to the [[south]] of the Oneiric Isles where an ancient Emberian ship has run aground; could this be what you're searching for?
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要为座舰升级一件能穿透其强力力场的装置。##你在梦幻群岛[[以南]]发现了一座[[荒漠岛]]，一艘古余烬船搁浅在那里；这会不会就是你要找的东西？

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter. ##On a desert island you found a man who claims to be the descendant of Emberian castaways; he says if you can find [[two switches]] in the various shacks on the island, you can unlock the [[Emberian wreck]] and reclaim its powerful [[Rasmussen Sphere.]]
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要升级座舰。##在荒漠岛上，你遇到一个男人，自称是余烬海难者的后裔；他说，只要在岛上各处小屋里找到[[两个开关]]，就能解锁[[余烬沉船]]，取回其中强大的[[拉斯穆森球体]]。

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter with a device that can pierce its powerful force-fields. ##You've found a [[desert island]] to the [[south]] of the Oneiric Isles where an ancient Emberian ship has run aground, and have flicked a mysterious switch that didn't seem to do anything. You should explore further.
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要为座舰升级一件能穿透其强力力场的装置。##你在梦幻群岛[[以南]]发现了一座[[荒漠岛]]，一艘古余烬船搁浅在那里，你还扳动了一个神秘的开关，但它似乎毫无反应。你应该继续探索。

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter. ##On a desert island you found a man who claims to be the descendant of Emberian castaways; he says if you can find [[one more switch]] in the various shacks on the island, you can unlock the [[Emberian wreck]] and reclaim its powerful [[Rasmussen Sphere.]]
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要升级座舰。##在荒漠岛上，你遇到一个男人，自称是余烬海难者的后裔；他说，只要在岛上各处小屋里再找到[[一个开关]]，就能解锁[[余烬沉船]]，取回其中强大的[[拉斯穆森球体]]。

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter with a device that can pierce its powerful force-fields. ##You've found a [[desert island]] to the [[south]] of the Oneiric Isles where an ancient Emberian ship has run aground, and you have flicked two switches that have disabled the wreck's security systems. You should search inside.
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要为座舰升级一件能穿透其强力力场的装置。##你在梦幻群岛[[以南]]发现了一座[[荒漠岛]]，一艘古余烬船搁浅在那里。你扳下了两个开关，解除了沉船的安保系统。你应该进去搜一搜。

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter. On a desert island you found an Emberian [[Rasmussen Sphere,]] which should allow the cutter to bypass the Cradle's protective force-field. ##You should return to the High Confessor with what you've found.
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要升级座舰。在荒漠岛上，你找到了余烬人的[[拉斯穆森球体]]，它应能让座舰穿透摇篮的防护力场。##带着你的发现回去见至高忏悔者吧。

English: To face Vela in the Cradle, you'll need to upgrade the cutter. On a desert island you found an Emberian [[Rasmussen Sphere,]] which should allow the cutter to bypass the Cradle's protective force-field.
Chinese: 要在摇篮中直面薇拉，你需要升级座舰。在荒漠岛上，你找到了余烬人的[[拉斯穆森球体]]，它应能让座舰穿透摇篮的防护力场。

English: To The Skies
Chinese: 飞向天际

English: To continue your pursuit of Vela Callose, you are going to need an [[airship.]] ##The High Confessor has given you a Writ of Permission that will enable you to purchase one. You should visit one of the [[Winged Merchant Guild towers]] in either Pwyll Village, Hallow Town, Sepulchre or Ferropolis.
Chinese: 要继续追捕薇拉·卡洛斯，你需要一艘[[飞艇]]。##至高忏悔者已给你一张许可状，凭它可以购买飞艇。去普威尔村、哈洛镇、陵墓城或铁城的[[飞翼商会高塔]]看看吧。

English: To continue your pursuit of Vela Callose, you are going to need an [[airship.]] ##You need to amass [[200 coin]] before purchasing one from a [[Winged Merchant Guild tower]] in either Pwyll Village, Hallow Town, Sepulchre or Ferropolis.
Chinese: 要继续追捕薇拉·卡洛斯，你需要一艘[[飞艇]]。##你得先攒够[[200 硬币]]，才能从普威尔村、哈洛镇、陵墓城或铁城的[[飞翼商会高塔]]购买一艘。

English: You've purchased an airship, and are now a veritable sky captain.
Chinese: 你买下了一艘飞艇，如今已是名副其实的天空船长。

English: War Stories
Chinese: 战争往事

English: Drangorg, an old God War veteran in Hallow Town,  told you about [[Aristide's Rock]] - where a legendary battle was fought. However, you won't be able to visit it unless you have access to an airship.
Chinese: 哈洛镇的神战老兵德兰戈格向你讲起[[亚里士提德之岩]]——一场传奇战役的战场。不过，除非你有飞艇，否则无法前往。

English: You found a silver pendant in the huge machine at Aristide's Rock, which seems to belong to the officer who Drangorg told you about.##Return it to Drangorg in his house in [[Hallow Town.]]
Chinese: 你在亚里士提德之岩的巨型机器里发现一枚银吊坠，似乎属于德兰戈格提到的那位军官。##把它送回[[哈洛镇]]德兰戈格的家里。

English: You found a silver pendant, which seemed to belong to the officer who Drangorg told you about.## You returned this to Drangorg and claimed your reward.
Chinese: 你发现了一枚银吊坠，似乎属于德兰戈格提到的那位军官。##你把它还给了德兰戈格，领到了报酬。

English: Belly of the Beast
Chinese: 兽腹之中

English: Inside a colossal creature you found a note that makes reference to a magic pickaxe. ##Perhaps this could be of use - you should delve further into the mollusc's innards and find out more.
Chinese: 在一头巨型生物体内，你发现一张字条，提到了一把魔法镐。##这或许有用——你应该深入这软体怪物的内脏，查个究竟。

English: Inside a colossal creature you found a note that speaks of the Temporal Pickaxe. Apparently, this pickaxe can defy time itself to recover ore from long-depleted veins. ##It is stored deep in the Intestinal Mines of the giant creature.
Chinese: 在一头巨型生物体内，你发现一张字条，讲的是时序镐。据说这把镐能违抗时间本身，从早已枯竭的矿脉中采回矿石。##它存放在巨型生物的肠道矿坑深处。

English: Inside a colossal creature you found the Temporal Pickaxe. Now, you can return to previously depleted ore veins and find more ore.
Chinese: 在一头巨型生物体内，你找到了时序镐。现在，你可以重返早已枯竭的矿脉，采出更多矿石。

English: Raiders of the Drifting Island
Chinese: 漂流岛夺宝奇兵

English: On a small island to the north-west, an adventurer tasked you with opening an ancient door. ##You must pull the lever on the island, then search the Oneiric Isles for ten secret switches before the time runs out.
Chinese: 在西北方的一座小岛上，一位冒险家交给你一个任务：打开一扇古门。##你必须扳下岛上的拉杆，然后在梦幻群岛中找出十个暗藏的开关，限时完成。

English: On a small island to the north-west, an adventurer tasked you with opening an ancient door. ##You must pull the lever on the island, then search the Oneiric Isles for ten secret switches before the time runs out. It seems the switches are a type of crystal skull.
Chinese: 在西北方的一座小岛上，一位冒险家交给你一个任务：打开一扇古门。##你必须扳下岛上的拉杆，然后在梦幻群岛中找出十个暗藏的开关，限时完成。那些开关似乎是一种水晶骷髅。

English: On a small island to the north-west, an adventurer tasked you with opening an ancient door. ##You activated all the crystal skulls before the time ran out, and should now return to the island to open the door...
Chinese: 在西北方的一座小岛上，一位冒险家交给你一个任务：打开一扇古门。##你在时限内激活了所有水晶骷髅，现在该回岛上开门了……

English: On a small island to the north-west, an adventurer tasked you with opening an ancient door. ##There was no treasure, so the whole endeavour was pointless. However, the adventurer gave you his prized ship cabin in recompense.
Chinese: 在西北方的一座小岛上，一位冒险家交给你一个任务：打开一扇古门。##门后并没有宝藏，整场折腾毫无意义。不过，冒险家把他珍爱的船舱送给你作为补偿。
